pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

/**
 * @title ERC721AQueryable
 * @dev Interface for ERC721AQueryable
 */
interface IERC721AQueryable {
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external;
    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external;
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external;
    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external;
    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address);
    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external;
    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool);
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256);
    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256);
}

contract ArtBlocksERC721A is IERC721AQueryable {
    // Events
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed approved, uint256 indexed tokenId);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event Mint(address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint256 indexed projectId);

    // Errors
    error ApprovalCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
    error ApprovalQueryForNonexistentToken();
    error ApproveToCaller();
    error BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
    error MintToZeroAddress();
    error MintZeroQuantity();
    error OwnerQueryForNonexistentToken();
    error TransferCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
    error TransferFromIncorrectOwner();
    error TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
    error TransferToZeroAddress();
    error URIQueryForNonexistentToken();
    error MintedQueryForZeroAddress();
    error IndexOutOfBounds();
    error OnlyAdmin();
    error OnlyArtist();
    error OnlyIfUnlocked();
    error ProjectMustExistAndBeActive();
    error MustNotExceedMaxPublications();
    error CannotExceed10000();
    error Max25();
    error Max100();
    error TokenIDDoesNotExist();
    error ScriptIdOutOfRange();
    error ThereAreNoScriptsToRemove();
    error MustEndAtLeastPrice();

    // Structs
    struct Project {
        address artistAddress;
        address additionalPayee;
        uint256 additionalPayeePercentage;
        uint256 pricePerTokenInWei;
        uint256 maxPublications;
        uint256 publications;
        bool active;
        address scriptContract;
        uint256 royaltyPercentage;
    }

    struct TokenInfo {
        bytes32 hash;
        uint256 projectId;
    }

    // Storage
    address private _admin;
    address private _baeowpAddress;
    uint256 private _baeowpPercentage;
    uint256 private _nextProjectId;
    string private _baseURI;
    string private _baseIpfsURI;
    address private _randomizerContract;

    // Mappings
    mapping(uint256 => Project) private _projects;
    mapping(uint256 => TokenInfo) private _tokens;
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) private _hashToTokenId;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => string)) private _projectScripts;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _projectScriptCount;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _projectScriptJSON;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _projectBaseURI;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _projectBaseIpfsURI;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _projectResourceJSON;
    mapping(uint256 => string) private _projectAdditionalJson;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _projectScriptIndex;

    constructor() {
        _admin = msg.sender;
        _nextProjectId = 0;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        if (msg.sender != _admin) revert OnlyAdmin();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyArtist(uint256 projectId) {
        if (msg.sender != _projects[projectId].artistAddress) revert OnlyArtist();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyIfUnlocked(uint256 projectId) {
        if (_projects[projectId].scriptContract != address(0)) revert OnlyIfUnlocked();
        _;
    }

    modifier projectExists(uint256 projectId) {
        if (projectId >= _nextProjectId) revert ProjectMustExistAndBeActive();
        _;
    }

    // ERC721AQueryable Implementation
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure override returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f;
    }

    function balanceOf(address owner) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (owner == address(0)) revert BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
        return _balances[owner];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (address) {
        address owner = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (owner == address(0)) revert OwnerQueryForNonexistentToken();
        return owner;
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) public override {
        _safeTransfer(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) public override {
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (to == owner) revert ApproveToCaller();
        if (msg.sender != owner && !isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender)) {
            revert ApprovalCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
        }
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(owner, to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view override returns (address) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) revert ApprovalQueryForNonexistentToken();
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public override {
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) public view override returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner][operator];
    }

    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _nextProjectId;
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address owner, uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (index >= balanceOf(owner)) revert IndexOutOfBounds();
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i; i < _nextProjectId; ++i) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                if (count == index) return i;
                ++count;
            }
        }
        revert IndexOutOfBounds();
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (index >= totalSupply()) revert IndexOutOfBounds();
        return index;
    }

    // Art Blocks Functions
    function name() external pure returns (string memory) {
        return "Art Blocks ERC721A";
    }

    function symbol() external pure returns (string memory) {
        return "AB721A";
    }

    function admin() external view returns (address) {
        return _admin;
    }

    function baeowpAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _baeowpAddress;
    }

    function baeowpPercentage() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _baeowpPercentage;
    }

    function nextProjectId() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _nextProjectId;
    }

    function randomizerContract() external view returns (address) {
        return _randomizerContract;
    }

    function tokenIdToHash(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _tokens[tokenId].hash;
    }

    function tokenIdToProjectId(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _tokens[tokenId].projectId;
    }

    function hashToTokenId(bytes32 hash) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hashToTokenId[hash];
    }

    function projectDetails(uint256 projectId) external view returns (address, address, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, bool) {
        Project storage p = _projects[projectId];
        return (p.artistAddress, p.additionalPayee, p.additionalPayeePercentage, p.pricePerTokenInWei, p.maxPublications, p.publications, p.active);
    }

    function projectScriptInfo(uint256 projectId) external view returns (uint256, string memory, string memory) {
        return (_projectScriptCount[projectId], _projectScriptJSON[projectId], _projectBaseURI[projectId]);
    }

    function projectTokenInfo(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256, address, uint256, address, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 projectId = _tokens[tokenId].projectId;
        Project storage p = _projects[projectId];
        return (projectId, p.artistAddress, p.pricePerTokenInWei, p.additionalPayee, p.additionalPayeePercentage, p.royaltyPercentage);
    }

    function projectScriptByIndex(uint256 projectId, uint256 index) external view returns (string memory) {
        if (index >= _projectScriptCount[projectId]) revert ScriptIdOutOfRange();
        return _projectScripts[projectId][index];
    }

    function projectShowAllTokens(uint256 projectId) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i; i < _nextProjectId; ++i) {
            if (_tokens[i].projectId == projectId) ++count;
        }
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](count);
        uint256 idx;
        for (uint256 i; i < _nextProjectId; ++i) {
            if (_tokens[i].projectId == projectId) {
                tokens[idx++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function projectURIInfo(uint256 projectId) external view returns (string memory, string memory) {
        return (_projectBaseURI[projectId], _projectBaseIpfsURI[projectId]);
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address owner) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 balance = balanceOf(owner);
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](balance);
        uint256 count;
        for (uint256 i; i < _nextProjectId; ++i) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                tokens[count++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function getRoyaltyData(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address, uint256) {
        uint256 projectId = _tokens[tokenId].projectId;
        Project storage p = _projects[projectId];
        return (p.artistAddress, p.royaltyPercentage);
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        if (!_exists(tokenId)) revert URIQueryForNonexistentToken();
        uint256 projectId = _tokens[tokenId].projectId;
        return string(abi.encodePacked(_projectBaseURI[projectId], Strings.toString(tokenId)));
    }

    // Admin Functions
    function addProject(address artistAddress, uint256 pricePerTokenInWei) external onlyAdmin {
        uint256 projectId = _nextProjectId++;
        Project storage p = _projects[projectId];
        p.artistAddress = artistAddress;
        p.pricePerTokenInWei = pricePerTokenInWei;
        p.active = false;
    }

    function updateProjectPricePerTokenInWei(uint256 projectId, uint256 pricePerTokenInWei) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projects[projectId].pricePerTokenInWei = pricePerTokenInWei;
    }

    function updateProjectArtistAddress(uint256 projectId, address artistAddress) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projects[projectId].artistAddress = artistAddress;
    }

    function updateProjectMaxPublications(uint256 projectId, uint256 maxPublications) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        if (maxPublications > 25) revert Max25();
        _projects[projectId].maxPublications = maxPublications;
    }

    function updateProjectSecondaryMarketRoyaltyPercentage(uint256 projectId, uint256 royaltyPercentage) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        if (royaltyPercentage > 100) revert Max100();
        _projects[projectId].royaltyPercentage = royaltyPercentage;
    }

    function updateProjectAdditionalPayeeInfo(uint256 projectId, address additionalPayee, uint256 additionalPayeePercentage) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projects[projectId].additionalPayee = additionalPayee;
        _projects[projectId].additionalPayeePercentage = additionalPayeePercentage;
    }

    function toggleProjectIsActive(uint256 projectId) external onlyAdmin projectExists(projectId) {
        _projects[projectId].active = !_projects[projectId].active;
    }

    function updateBaeowpAddress(address baeowpAddress_) external onlyAdmin {
        _baeowpAddress = baeowpAddress_;
    }

    function updateBaeowpPercentage(uint256 baeowpPercentage_) external onlyAdmin {
        if (baeowpPercentage_ > 100) revert Max100();
        _baeowpPercentage = baeowpPercentage_;
    }

    function updateRandomizerAddress(address randomizerContract_) external onlyAdmin {
        _randomizerContract = randomizerContract_;
    }

    // Script Management
    function addProjectScript(uint256 projectId, string calldata script) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        uint256 index = _projectScriptCount[projectId]++;
        _projectScripts[projectId][index] = script;
    }

    function updateProjectScript(uint256 projectId, uint256 scriptIndex, string calldata script) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        if (scriptIndex >= _projectScriptCount[projectId]) revert ScriptIdOutOfRange();
        _projectScripts[projectId][scriptIndex] = script;
    }

    function removeProjectLastScript(uint256 projectId) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        if (_projectScriptCount[projectId] == 0) revert ThereAreNoScriptsToRemove();
        _projectScriptCount[projectId]--;
    }

    function updateProjectScriptJSON(uint256 projectId, string calldata scriptJSON) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projectScriptJSON[projectId] = scriptJSON;
    }

    function updateProjectBaseURI(uint256 projectId, string calldata baseURI) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projectBaseURI[projectId] = baseURI;
    }

    function updateProjectResourceIpfsHash(uint256 projectId, string calldata ipfsHash) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projectBaseIpfsURI[projectId] = ipfsHash;
    }

    function updateProjectResourceJSON(uint256 projectId, string calldata resourceJSON) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projectResourceJSON[projectId] = resourceJSON;
    }

    function updateProjectAdditionalJson(uint256 projectId, string calldata additionalJson) external onlyArtist(projectId) projectExists(projectId) {
        _projectAdditionalJson[projectId] = additionalJson;
    }

    // Purchase Functions
    function purchase(uint256 projectId) external payable returns (uint256) {
        return _purchase(msg.sender, projectId);
    }

    function purchaseTo(address to, uint256 projectId) external payable returns (uint256) {
        return _purchase(to, projectId);
    }

    function _purchase(address to, uint256 projectId) internal returns (uint256 tokenId) {
        Project storage p = _projects[projectId];
        
        if (projectId >= _nextProjectId || !p.active) revert ProjectMustExistAndBeActive();
        if (p.publications >= p.maxPublications) revert MustNotExceedMaxPublications();
        
        uint256 price = p.pricePerTokenInWei;
        if (msg.value < price) revert MustEndAtLeastPrice();
        
        tokenId = _nextProjectId++;
        
        _tokens[tokenId].projectId = projectId;
        _tokens[tokenId].hash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.number - 1), msg.sender, block.timestamp, tokenId));
        
        _hashToTokenId[_tokens[tokenId].hash] = tokenId;
        
        p.publications++;
        
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        
        emit Mint(to, tokenId, projectId);
        
        // Handle payments
        _handlePayment(p, price);
        
        // Refund excess
        if (msg.value > price) {
            payable(msg.sender).transfer(msg.value - price);
        }
    }

    function _handlePayment(Project storage p, uint256 price) internal {
        uint256 baeowpAmount = (price * _baeowpPercentage) / 100;
        uint256 artistAmount = price - baeowpAmount;
        
        if (p.additionalPayeePercentage > 0) {
            uint256 additionalPayeeAmount = (artistAmount * p.additionalPayeePercentage) / 100;
            artistAmount -= additionalPayeeAmount;
            
            if (additionalPayeeAmount > 0) {
                payable(p.additionalPayee).transfer(additionalPayeeAmount);
            }
        }
        
        if (baeowpAmount > 0) {
            payable(_baeowpAddress).transfer(baeowpAmount);
        }
        
        if (artistAmount > 0) {
            payable(p.artistAddress).transfer(artistAmount);
        }
    }

    // Internal ERC721 Functions
    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _tokens[tokenId].projectId != 0 || tokenId == 0;
    }

    function _ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(tokenId)))));
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) revert MintToZeroAddress();
        
        _balances[to] += 1;
        
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) revert TransferToZeroAddress();
        
        address owner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        if (from != owner) revert TransferFromIncorrectOwner();
        
        bool approved = msg.sender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender) || msg.sender == getApproved(tokenId);
        if (!approved) revert TransferCallerNotOwnerNorApproved();
        
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
                if (retval != IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector) {
                    revert TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
                }
            } catch {
                revert TransferToNonERC721ReceiverImplementer();
            }
        }
    }
}

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}

library Strings {
    function toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

    function safeTransfer(IERC20 token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transfer.selector, to, value);

        require(success && (returndata.length == 0 || abi.decode(returndata, (bool))), "SafeERC20: transfer failed");

    function safeTransferFrom(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(token.transferFrom.selector, from, to, value);
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = address(token).call(data);
        require(success && (returndata.length == 0 || abi.decode(returndata, (bool))), "SafeERC20: transferFrom failed");
    }

    function safeApprove(IERC20 token, address spender, uint256 value) internal {
        bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(token.approve.selector, spender, value);
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = address(token).call(data);

    }

        _approve(msg.sender, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance - amount);
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(sender != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");

        uint256 senderBalance = _balances[sender];
        require(senderBalance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount;
        _balances[recipient] += amount;

        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");
        _totalSupply += amount;
        _balances[account] += amount;
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");
        uint256 accountBalance = _balances[account];
        require(accountBalance >= amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount;
        _totalSupply -= amount;
        emit Transfer(account, address(0), amount);
    }

    function depositSavings(uint256 _amount, address _referrer) external onlySavingsManager {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(msg.sender, credits);
        
        _poke();
        
        emit SavingsDeposited(msg.sender, _amount, credits);
        emit Deposit(MUSD, msg.sender, _amount, credits);
        
        if (_referrer != address(0)) {
            emit Referral(_referrer, msg.sender, _amount);
        }
    }

    function depositSavings(uint256 _amount, address _mAsset, address _referrer) external onlySavingsManager {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_mAsset == MUSD, "Invalid mAsset");
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(msg.sender, credits);
        
        _poke();
        
        emit SavingsDeposited(msg.sender, _amount, credits);
        emit Deposit(_mAsset, msg.sender, _amount, credits);
        
        if (_referrer != address(0)) {
            emit Referral(_referrer, msg.sender, _amount);
        }
    }

    function deposit(uint256 _amount, address _beneficiary) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_beneficiary != address(0), "Invalid beneficiary address");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(_beneficiary, credits);
        
        _poke();
        
        emit Deposit(MUSD, _beneficiary, _amount, credits);
    }

    function deposit(uint256 _amount, address _beneficiary, address _referrer) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must deposit something");
        require(_beneficiary != address(0), "Invalid beneficiary address");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(_beneficiary, credits);
        
        _poke();
        
        emit Deposit(MUSD, _beneficiary, _amount, credits);
        
        if (_referrer != address(0)) {
            emit Referral(_referrer, _beneficiary, _amount);
        }
    }

    function redeem(uint256 _credits) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
    }

    function redeem(uint256 _credits, address _recipient, address _beneficiary) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        require(_recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(_recipient, amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
        emit Withdraw(MUSD, msg.sender, _beneficiary, amount, _credits);
    }

    function redeemCredits(uint256 _credits) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
    }

    function redeemAndUnwrap(
        uint256 _credits,
        bool _isToken,
        uint256 _minAmountOut,
        address _output,
        address _beneficiary,
        address _router,
        bool _
    ) external {
        require(_credits > 0, "Must redeem something");
        require(_output != address(0), "Output address is zero");
        require(_beneficiary != address(0), "Beneficiary address is zero");
        require(_router != address(0), "Router address is zero");
        
        if (automateInterestCollection) {
            ISavingsManager(SAVINGS_MANAGER).collectAndDistributeInterest(MUSD);
        }
        
        uint256 amount = _convertFromCredits(_credits);
        _burn(msg.sender, _credits);
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeApprove(unwrapper, amount);
        IUnwrapper(unwrapper).unwrapAndSend(_isToken, _beneficiary, _output, _router, amount, _minAmountOut, _router);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, _credits, amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount, address _recipient, address _beneficiary) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        require(_recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(_recipient, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
        emit Withdraw(MUSD, msg.sender, _beneficiary, _amount, credits);
    }

    function redeemUnderlying(uint256 _amount) external {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= credits, "Amount exceeds balance");
        
        _burn(msg.sender, credits);
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        
        emit CreditsRedeemed(msg.sender, credits, _amount);
    }

    function emergencyWithdraw(uint256 _amount) external onlyPoker {
        require(_amount > 0, "Must withdraw something");
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransfer(msg.sender, _amount);
        
        emit EmergencyUpdate();
    }

    function poke() external onlyPoker {
        _poke();
    }

    function _poke() internal {
        uint256 balance = IERC20(MUSD).balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 newExchangeRate = _calculateExchangeRate(balance);
        
        if (newExchangeRate > exchangeRate) {
            exchangeRate = newExchangeRate;
            emit ExchangeRateUpdated(newExchangeRate, exchangeRate);
        }
        
        lastPokeTime = block.timestamp;
        lastPokeBalance = balance;
        
        emit Poked(balance, 0, newExchangeRate);
    }

    function _calculateExchangeRate(uint256 balance) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalSupply == 0) return 1e18;
        return (balance * 1e18) / _totalSupply;
    }

    function _convertToCredits(uint256 _amount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return (_amount * 1e18) / exchangeRate;
    }

    function _convertFromCredits(uint256 _credits) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return (_credits * exchangeRate) / 1e18;
    }

    function convertToShares(uint256 _amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertToCredits(_amount);
    }

    function convertToAssets(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function previewDeposit(uint256 _amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertToCredits(_amount);
    }

    function previewMint(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function previewWithdraw(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function previewRedeem(uint256 _shares) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_shares);
    }

    function maxDeposit(address) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return type(uint256).max;
    }

    function maxMint(address) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return type(uint256).max;
    }

    function maxWithdraw(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_balances[_owner]);
    }

    function maxRedeem(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[_owner];
    }

    function balanceOfUnderlying(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_balances[_owner]);
    }

    function creditBalances(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[_owner];
    }

    function underlyingToCredits(uint256 _amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertToCredits(_amount);
    }

    function creditsToUnderlying(uint256 _credits) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertFromCredits(_credits);
    }

    function asset() external view returns (address) {
        return MUSD;
    }

    function lastBalance() external view returns (uint256) {
        return IERC20(MUSD).balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function setConnector(address _connector) external onlyGovernor {
        connector = _connector;
        emit ConnectorUpdated(_connector);
    }

    function setPoker(address _poker) external onlyGovernor {
        _setPoker(_poker);
    }

    function _setPoker(address _poker) internal {
        require(_poker != address(0) || _getPoker() == _poker, "Invalid poker address");
        // Store poker in slot 0x3a
        assembly {
            sstore(0x3a, or(and(sload(0x3a), 0xffffffffffffffffffffffff00000000000000000000000000000000), _poker))
        }
        emit PokerUpdated(_poker);
    }

    function _getPoker() internal view returns (address poker) {
        assembly {
            poker := and(sload(0x3a), 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff)
        }
    }

    function poker() external view returns (address) {
        return _getPoker();
    }

    function setFraction(uint256 _fraction) external onlyPoker {
        require(_fraction <= 50e16, "Fraction must be <= 50%");
        fraction = _fraction;
        emit FractionUpdated(_fraction);
    }

    function fraction() external view returns (uint256) {
        return fraction;
    }

    function automateInterestCollectionFlag(bool _enabled) external onlyPoker {
        automateInterestCollection = _enabled;
        emit AutomaticInterestCollectionSwitched(_enabled);
    }

    function unwrapper() external view returns (address) {
        return unwrapper;
    }

    function connector() external view returns (address) {
        return connector;
    }

    function nexus() external view returns (address) {
        return nexus;
    }

    function governor() external view returns (address) {
        return INexus(nexus).governor();
    }

    function mint(uint256 _amount, address _recipient) external {

        }
        
        IERC20(MUSD).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
        
        uint256 credits = _convertToCredits(_amount);
        _mint(_recipient, credits);
        
        emit Deposit(MUSD, _recipient, _amount, credits);
    }

    function mint(uint256 _amount, address _recipient, address _referrer) external {

        }
    }

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract ThreePointNFT {
    // ============ Constants ============
    bytes32 private constant _OPERATOR_ROLE = 0xc88390e7e62175be0932452175b6a7222b6b094ab0ef984a5153c620345d8975;
    bytes32 private constant _MINTER_ROLE = 0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6;
    bytes32 private constant _THREE_POINT_MINTER_ROLE = 0xfb;
    bytes32 private constant _RESERVED_MINTER_ROLE = 0xc9;
    bytes32 private constant _GAME_KEY_SLOT = 0xca;
    bytes32 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC1155 = 0xd9b67a26;
    bytes32 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC1155_METADATA_URI = 0x0e89341c;
    bytes32 private constant _INTERFACE_ID_ERC165 = 0x01ffc9a7;

    // ============ Storage Slots ============
    // Slot 0x00: initialized + reentrancy guard
    // Slot 0x01: owner (packed)
    // Slot 0x02: reentrancy guard
    // Slot 0x03: totalThreePointSupply
    // Slot 0x04: gameRootKey
    // Slot 0x05: name
    // Slot 0x06: symbol
    // Slot 0x07: uri prefix
    // Slot 0x08: maxSupply
    // Slot 0x09: totalReservedSupply
    // Slot 0x0a: mintPrice
    // Slot 0x0b: dropPhase
    // Slot 0x0c: maxMintCount
    // Slot 0x0d: gameInfo mapping
    // Slot 0x0e: threePointMinted mapping
    // Slot 0x0f: reservedMinted mapping
    // Slot 0x10: communityMinted mapping
    // Slot 0x11: isAirdroped flag
    // Slot 0x12: communityRoot
    // Slot 0x13: gcfRoot
    // Slot 0x14: royalty info
    // Slot 0x15: royaltyPercent
    // Slot 0x16: totalSupply
    // Slot 0x17: balance mapping
    // Slot 0x97: owner address

    // ============ Events ============
    event TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value);
    event TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values);
    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed account, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event Initialized(uint8 version);
    event claimedFromThreePoint(uint256 indexed count, address indexed account);

    // ============ Errors ============
    error ERC1155InsufficientBalance(address account, uint256 needed, uint256 balance);
    error ERC1155InvalidOperator(address operator);
    error ERC1155MissingApprovalForAll(address operator, address owner);
    error ERC1155TransferToNonERC1155ReceiverImplementer(address to);
    error ERC1155ReceiverRejectedTokens();
    error ERC1155TransferToZeroAddress();
    error ERC1155BurnFromZeroAddress();
    error ERC1155MintToZeroAddress();
    error ERC1155BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
    error ERC1155IdsAndAmountsLengthMismatch();
    error ERC1155InsufficientApprovalForAll(address operator, address owner);
    error OwnableCallerIsNotTheOwner(address caller);
    error OwnableNewOwnerIsTheZeroAddress();
    error OwnableCallerIsNotTheAdmin(address caller);
    error AccessControlCanOnlyRenounceRolesForSelf();
    error AccessControlAccountIsMissingRole(address account, bytes32 role);
    error ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall();
    error InvalidInterfaceId();
    error AlreadyMintedToAddress();
    error AlreadyMintedAllNFTs();
    error SupplyShouldBePositive();
    error MaxMintCountShouldNotBe0();
    error MintPriceShouldNotBe0();
    error DropPhaseShouldBeNotGreaterThan3();
    error AlreadyAirdroped();
    error OverflowMaxSupply();
    error TooManyCountForOneTransaction();
    error MintPriceIsNotEnough();
    error NotEnoughReservedToken();
    error NotTheDropPeriod();
    error NeedOperatorApprovalFor3rdPartyBurns();
    error StringsHexLengthInsufficient();
    error InitializableContractIsAlreadyInitialized();
    error InitializableContractIsNotInitializing();

    // ============ Modifiers ============
    modifier nonReentrant() {
        if (uint256(_getStorageUint(0x02)) != 0) revert ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall();
        _setStorageUint(0x02, 1);
        _;
        _setStorageUint(0x02, 0);
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        if (_getOwner() != msg.sender) revert OwnableCallerIsNotTheOwner(msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        if (!_hasRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert OwnableCallerIsNotTheAdmin(msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    modifier initializing() {
        uint8 initialized = uint8(_getStorageUint(0x00) >> 8);
        if (initialized >= 1) revert InitializableContractIsAlreadyInitialized();
        _setStorageUint(0x00, _getStorageUint(0x00) | 0x0100);
        _;
    }

    // ============ Storage Helpers ============
    function _getOwner() internal view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(_getStorageUint(0x97)));
    }

    function _setOwner(address newOwner) internal {
        _setStorageUint(0x97, uint256(uint160(newOwner)));
    }

    function _getStorageUint(uint256 slot) internal view returns (uint256 value) {
        assembly { value := sload(slot) }
    }

    function _setStorageUint(uint256 slot, uint256 value) internal {
        assembly { sstore(slot, value) }
    }

    function _getStorageBytes32(uint256 slot) internal view returns (bytes32 value) {
        assembly { value := sload(slot) }
    }

    function _setStorageBytes32(uint256 slot, bytes32 value) internal {
        assembly { sstore(slot, value) }
    }

    function _getPackedAddress(uint256 slot) internal view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(_getStorageUint(slot) & ((1 << 160) - 1)));
    }

    function _setPackedAddress(uint256 slot, address value) internal {
        uint256 packed = _getStorageUint(slot) & ~((1 << 160) - 1);
        _setStorageUint(slot, packed | uint256(uint160(value)));
    }

    function _hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(role, account)));
        return (_getStorageUint(slot) & 0xff) != 0;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(role, account)));
        _setStorageUint(slot, _getStorageUint(slot) | 1);
        emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(role, account)));
        _setStorageUint(slot, _getStorageUint(slot) & ~0xff);
        emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
    }

        if (status) {
            _grantRole(role, account);
        } else {
            _revokeRole(role, account);
        }
    }

    function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (account == address(0)) revert ERC1155BalanceQueryForZeroAddress();
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, account)));
        return _getStorageUint(slot) & 0xff;
    }

    function balanceOfBatch(address[] memory accounts, uint256[] memory ids) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        if (accounts.length != ids.length) revert ERC1155IdsAndAmountsLengthMismatch();
        uint256[] memory balances = new uint256[](accounts.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            balances[i] = balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]);
        }
        return balances;
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        if (operator == msg.sender) revert ERC1155InvalidOperator(operator);
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, operator)));
        _setStorageUint(slot, approved ? 1 : 0);
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, operator)));
        return (_getStorageUint(slot) & 0xff) != 0;
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) public {
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC1155TransferToZeroAddress();
        if (from != msg.sender && !isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC1155InsufficientApprovalForAll(msg.sender, from);
        
        uint256 fromSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, from)));
        uint256 fromBalance = _getStorageUint(fromSlot) & 0xff;
        if (fromBalance < amount) revert ERC1155InsufficientBalance(from, amount, fromBalance);
        
        _setStorageUint(fromSlot, fromBalance - amount);
        uint256 toSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, to)));
        _setStorageUint(toSlot, (_getStorageUint(toSlot) & 0xff) + amount);
        
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) public {
        if (ids.length != amounts.length) revert ERC1155IdsAndAmountsLengthMismatch();
        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC1155TransferToZeroAddress();
        if (from != msg.sender && !isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender)) revert ERC1155InsufficientApprovalForAll(msg.sender, from);
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            
            uint256 fromSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, from)));
            uint256 fromBalance = _getStorageUint(fromSlot) & 0xff;
            if (fromBalance < amount) revert ERC1155InsufficientBalance(from, amount, fromBalance);
            
            _setStorageUint(fromSlot, fromBalance - amount);
            uint256 toSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, to)));
            _setStorageUint(toSlot, (_getStorageUint(toSlot) & 0xff) + amount);
        }
        
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, from, to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

        if (to == address(0)) revert ERC1155MintToZeroAddress();
        
        uint256 toSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, to)));
        _setStorageUint(toSlot, (_getStorageUint(toSlot) & 0xff) + amount);
        
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) revert ERC1155BurnFromZeroAddress();
        
        uint256 fromSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(id, from)));
        uint256 fromBalance = _getStorageUint(fromSlot) & 0xff;
        if (fromBalance < amount) revert ERC1155InsufficientBalance(from, amount, fromBalance);
        
        _setStorageUint(fromSlot, fromBalance - amount);
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function burn(address account, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public {
        if (account != msg.sender && !isApprovedForAll(account, msg.sender)) {
            revert NeedOperatorApprovalFor3rdPartyBurns();
        }
        _burn(account, id, amount);
    }

    // ============ Receiver Checks ============
    function _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) private {

        }
    }

        if (to.code.length == 0) return;

        } catch {
            revert ERC1155TransferToNonERC1155ReceiverImplementer(to);

    }

    function uri(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {

    }

    function name() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _getStorageString(0x05);
    }

        if (len == 0) return "";
        
        uint256 dataSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(slot)));
        bytes memory data = new bytes(len);
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i += 32) {
            uint256 chunk = _getStorageUint(dataSlot + i / 32);
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i + j < len; j++) {
                data[i + j] = bytes1(chunk >> (248 - j * 8));
            }
        }
        return string(data);
    }

    function _toHex(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes16 alphabet = "0123456789abcdef";
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(64);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            buffer[i] = alphabet[(value >> (252 - i * 4)) & 0xf];
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    // ============ Royalty ============
    function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice) public view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = _getOwner();
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _getStorageUint(0x15)) / 100;
    }

    function royalty() public view returns (address, uint256) {
        return (_getOwner(), _getStorageUint(0x15));
    }

    function royaltyPercent() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x15);
    }

    // ============ Ownership ============
    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _getOwner();
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert OwnableNewOwnerIsTheZeroAddress();
        address oldOwner = _getOwner();
        _setOwner(newOwner);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        address oldOwner = _getOwner();
        _setOwner(address(0));
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, address(0));
    }

    // ============ Admin Management ============
    function addAdmin(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _grantRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, account);
    }

    function removeAdmin(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _revokeRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, account);
    }

    // ============ Minter Management ============
    function addMinter(address account) public onlyAdmin {
        _grantRole(_MINTER_ROLE, account);
    }

    function removeMinter(address account) public onlyAdmin {
        _revokeRole(_MINTER_ROLE, account);
    }

    function MINTER_ROLE() public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return _MINTER_ROLE;
    }

    function DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE() public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return 0x00;
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return _OPERATOR_ROLE;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _hasRole(role, account);
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyAdmin {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyAdmin {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        if (account != msg.sender) revert AccessControlCanOnlyRenounceRolesForSelf();
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    // ============ Supply Management ============
    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x16);
    }

    function maxSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x08);
    }

    function totalReservedSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x09);
    }

    function totalThreePointSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x03);
    }

    function setMaxSupply(uint256 newMaxSupply) public onlyAdmin {
        if (newMaxSupply == 0) revert SupplyShouldBePositive();
        _setStorageUint(0x08, newMaxSupply);
    }

    // ============ Mint Price ============
    function mintPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x0a);
    }

    function setMintPrice(uint256 newPrice) public onlyOwner {
        if (newPrice == 0) revert MintPriceShouldNotBe0();
        _setStorageUint(0x0a, newPrice);
    }

    // ============ Max Mint Count ============
    function maxMintCount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x0c);
    }

    function setMaxMintCount(uint256 newCount) public onlyOwner {
        if (newCount == 0) revert MaxMintCountShouldNotBe0();
        _setStorageUint(0x0c, newCount);
    }

    // ============ Drop Phase ============
    function dropPhase() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _getStorageUint(0x0b);
    }

    function setDropPhase(uint256 phase) public onlyOwner {
        if (phase > 3) revert DropPhaseShouldBeNotGreaterThan3();
        _setStorageUint(0x0b, phase);
    }

    // ============ Reserve ============
    function reserve(uint256 count) public onlyAdmin {
        uint256 maxSupply = _getStorageUint(0x08);
        uint256 totalSupply = _getStorageUint(0x16);
        if (totalSupply + count > maxSupply) revert OverflowMaxSupply();
        
        uint256 maxMintCount = _getStorageUint(0x0c);
        if (count > maxMintCount) revert TooManyCountForOneTransaction();
        
        uint256 reservedSupply = _getStorageUint(0x09);
        _setStorageUint(0x09, reservedSupply + count);
        _setStorageUint(0x16, totalSupply + count);
    }

    function reserveCount(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, uint256(0x0f))));
        return _getStorageUint(slot) & 0xff;
    }

    // ============ Airdrop ============
    function isAirdroped() public view returns (bool) {
        return (_getStorageUint(0x11) & 0xff) != 0;
    }

    function mintForAirdrop(uint256 count) public onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        if (isAirdroped()) revert AlreadyAirdroped();
        
        uint256 maxSupply = _getStorageUint(0x08);
        uint256 totalSupply = _getStorageUint(0x16);
        if (totalSupply + count > maxSupply) revert OverflowMaxSupply();
        
        uint256 maxMintCount = _getStorageUint(0x0c);
        if (count > maxMintCount) revert TooManyCountForOneTransaction();
        
        _mint(msg.sender, 0, count, "");
        _setStorageUint(0x16, totalSupply + count);
        _setStorageUint(0x11, 1);
    }

    // ============ Three Point Mint ============
    function claimFromThreePoint(uint256 count, bytes32[] memory proof, address account) public onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        uint256 maxSupply = _getStorageUint(0x08);
        uint256 totalSupply = _getStorageUint(0x16);
        if (totalSupply >= maxSupply) revert AlreadyMintedAllNFTs();
        
        uint256 threePointSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0x0e), account)));
        if ((_getStorageUint(threePointSlot) & 0xff) != 0) revert AlreadyMintedToAddress();
        
        uint256 maxMintCount = _getStorageUint(0x0c);
        if (count > maxMintCount) revert TooManyCountForOneTransaction();
        
        // Verify merkle proof (simplified)
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, count));
        // Proof verification would be implemented here
        
        _mint(account, 0, count, "");
        _setStorageUint(threePointSlot, 1);
        _setStorageUint(0x03, _getStorageUint(0x03) + count);
        _setStorageUint(0x16, totalSupply + count);
        
        emit claimedFromThreePoint(count, account);
    }

    // ============ Community Mint ============
    function communityRoot() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _getStorageBytes32(0x12);
    }

    function setCommunityRoot(bytes32 newRoot) public onlyAdmin {
        _setStorageBytes32(0x12, newRoot);
    }

    function mintedForCommunity(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0x10), account)));
        return (_getStorageUint(slot) & 0xff) != 0;
    }

    // ============ GCF ============
    function gcfRoot() public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _getStorageBytes32(0x13);
    }

    function setGCFRoot(bytes32 newRoot) public onlyAdmin {
        _setStorageBytes32(0x13, newRoot);
    }

    function mintedForGCF(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0xfb), account)));
        return (_getStorageUint(slot + 1) & 0xff) != 0;
    }

    // ============ Game Info ============
    function gameInfo(uint256 gameId) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0x0d), gameId)));
        return (_getStorageUint(slot), _getStorageUint(slot + 1), _getStorageUint(slot + 2));
    }

    function setGameRootKey(uint256 gameId, bytes32 key, uint256 value) public onlyAdmin {
        uint256 slot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0xca), gameId)));
        _setStorageBytes32(slot, key);
        _setStorageUint(slot + 1, value);
    }

    // ============ Token URI Prefix ============
    function tokenURIPrefix() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _getStorageString(0x07);
    }

    // ============ Mint Functions ============
    function mint(uint256 count, bytes32[] memory proof) public payable nonReentrant {
        uint256 phase = _getStorageUint(0x0b);
        if (phase == 0) revert NotTheDropPeriod();
        
        uint256 maxSupply = _getStorageUint(0x08);
        uint256 totalSupply = _getStorageUint(0x16);
        if (totalSupply + count > maxSupply) revert OverflowMaxSupply();
        
        uint256 maxMintCount = _getStorageUint(0x0c);
        if (count > maxMintCount) revert TooManyCountForOneTransaction();
        
        uint256 price = _getStorageUint(0x0a);
        if (msg.value < price * count) revert MintPriceIsNotEnough();
        
        uint256 mintedSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(uint256(0x0e), msg.sender)));
        if ((_getStorageUint(mintedSlot) & 0xff) != 0) revert AlreadyMintedToAddress();
        
        _mint(msg.sender, 0, count, "");
        _setStorageUint(mintedSlot, 1);
        _setStorageUint(0x16, totalSupply + count);
    }

    // ============ Withdraw ============
    function withdraw() public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }

    // ============ Initialize ============
    function initialize() public initializing {
        _setOwner(msg.sender);
        _grantRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);
        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function initialize(string memory name_, string memory symbol_, string memory uriPrefix_, address royaltyReceiver, bytes32 communityRoot_, bytes32 gcfRoot_) public initializing {
        _setStorageString(0x05, name_);
        _setStorageString(0x06, symbol_);
        _setStorageString(0x07, uriPrefix_);
        _setPackedAddress(0x14, royaltyReceiver);
        _setStorageUint(0x08, 0);
        _setStorageUint(0x09, 0);
        _setStorageUint(0x0c, 3);
        _setStorageUint(0x0a, 0xf8b0a10e470000); // ~0.028 ETH
        _setStorageUint(0x0b, 3);
        _setStorageBytes32(0x12, communityRoot_);
        _setStorageBytes32(0x13, gcfRoot_);
        
        _setOwner(msg.sender);
        _grantRole(_OPERATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);
        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function _setStorageString(uint256 slot, string memory str) internal {
        uint256 len = bytes(str).length;
        _setStorageUint(slot, (len << 1) | 1);
        
        if (len > 0) {
            uint256 dataSlot = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(slot)));
            bytes memory data = bytes(str);
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i += 32) {
                uint256 chunk;
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < 32 && i + j < len; j++) {
                    chunk |= uint256(uint8(data[i + j])) << (248 - j * 8);
                }
                _setStorageUint(dataSlot + i / 32, chunk);
            }
        }
    }
}

    }

    function _checkSignature(address signer, bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure {
        address recovered = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
        if (recovered == address(0) || recovered != signer) revert INVALID_SIGNATURE();
    }

        if (state != 2) revert INVALID_STATE();
        if (stakeholdersPoolAuthorized != msg.sender) revert BENEFICIARY_ONLY();
        if (amount > totalSupply) revert EXCESSIVE_SUPPLY();
        if (isSell) {
            _sell(from, to, amount, 0);
        } else {
            _buy(from, to, amount);
        }
    }

    function name() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function decimals() public pure returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _tTotal;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[account]) return _tOwned[account];
        return tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]);
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance");
        _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance - amount);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function isExcludedFromReward(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromReward[account];
    }

    function totalFees() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _tFeeTotal;
    }

    function tokenFromReflection(uint256 rAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(rAmount <= _rTotal, "Amount must be less than total reflections");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        return rAmount / currentRate;
    }

    function reflectionFromToken(uint256 tAmount, bool deductTransferFee) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(tAmount <= _tTotal, "Amount must be less than supply");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        if (!deductTransferFee) {
            return tAmount * currentRate;
        } else {
            uint256 rAmount = tAmount * currentRate;
            uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100 * currentRate);
            return rTransferAmount;
        }
    }

    function excludeFromReward(address account) public onlyOwner {
        require(!_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is already excluded");
        if (_rOwned[account] > 0) {
            _tOwned[account] = tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]);
        }
        _isExcludedFromReward[account] = true;
        _excluded.push(account);
    }

    function includeInReward(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_isExcludedFromReward[account], "Account is not excluded");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_excluded[i] == account) {
                _excluded[i] = _excluded[_excluded.length - 1];
                _tOwned[account] = 0;
                _isExcludedFromReward[account] = false;
                _excluded.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) private {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) private {
        require(sender != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(recipient != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");

        uint256 taxFee;
        uint256 liquidityFee;
        uint256 marketingFee;
        uint256 burnFee;

        if (sender != owner() && recipient != owner()) {
            if (!_tradingOpen) {
                require(_isExcludedFromFee[sender] || _isExcludedFromFee[recipient], "Trading not yet enabled");
            }

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[sender] && !_isExcludedFromMaxTx[recipient]) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Transfer amount exceeds the maxTxAmount");
                uint256 contractBalanceRefl = balanceOf(address(this));
                if (contractBalanceRefl > 0) {}
            }

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient] && !_isExcludedFromMaxTx[sender]) {
                require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Transfer amount exceeds the maxTxAmount");
            }

            if (!_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient] && !_isExcludedFromMaxWallet[recipient]) {
                require(balanceOf(recipient) + amount <= _maxWalletSize, "Max wallet size exceeded");
            }

            if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[sender]) {
                taxFee = _buyTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _buyLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _buyMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _buyBurnFee;
            } else if (_automatedMarketMakerPairs[recipient]) {
                taxFee = _sellTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _sellLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _sellMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _sellBurnFee;
            } else {
                taxFee = _transferTaxFee;
                liquidityFee = _transferLiquidityFee;
                marketingFee = _transferMarketingFee;
                burnFee = _transferBurnFee;
            }
        }

        _tokenTransfer(sender, recipient, amount, taxFee, liquidityFee, marketingFee, burnFee);
    }

    function _tokenTransfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) private {
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rAmount = amount * currentRate;
        uint256 rTaxFee = (amount * taxFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rLiquidityFee = (amount * liquidityFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rMarketingFee = (amount * marketingFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rBurnFee = (amount * burnFee / 100) * currentRate;
        uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - rTaxFee - rLiquidityFee - rMarketingFee - rBurnFee;

        if (_isExcludedFromReward[sender]) {
            _tOwned[sender] -= amount;
        }
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[recipient]) {
            _tOwned[recipient] += amount - (amount * (taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee) / 100);
        }

        _rOwned[sender] -= rAmount;
        _rOwned[recipient] += rTransferAmount;

        if (taxFee > 0) {
            _rTotal -= rTaxFee;
            _tFeeTotal += amount * taxFee / 100;
        }
        if (liquidityFee > 0) {
            _rOwned[address(this)] += rLiquidityFee;
        }
        if (marketingFee > 0) {
            _rOwned[_marketingWallet] += rMarketingFee;
        }
        if (burnFee > 0) {
            _rTotal -= rBurnFee;
            _tTotal -= amount * burnFee / 100;
        }

        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount - (amount * (taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee) / 100));
    }

    function _getRate() private view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 rSupply = _rTotal;
        uint256 tSupply = _tTotal;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_rOwned[_excluded[i]] > rSupply || _tOwned[_excluded[i]] > tSupply) return _rTotal / _tTotal;
            rSupply -= _rOwned[_excluded[i]];
            tSupply -= _tOwned[_excluded[i]];
        }
        if (rSupply < _rTotal / _tTotal) return _rTotal / _tTotal;
        return rSupply / tSupply;
    }

    function _getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 tTransferAmount = tAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100);
        uint256 rAmount = tAmount * _getRate();
        uint256 rTransferAmount = rAmount - (tAmount * _transferTaxFee / 100 * _getRate());
        return (rAmount, rTransferAmount, tTransferAmount);
    }

    function _reflectFee(uint256 rFee, uint256 tFee) private {
        _rTotal -= rFee;
        _tFeeTotal += tFee;
    }

    function _takeLiquidity(uint256 tLiquidity) private {
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        uint256 rLiquidity = tLiquidity * currentRate;
        _rOwned[address(this)] += rLiquidity;
        if (_isExcludedFromReward[address(this)]) {
            _tOwned[address(this)] += tLiquidity;
        }
    }

    function excludeFromFee(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromFee[account] = true;
    }

    function includeInFee(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromFee[account] = false;
    }

    function isExcludedFromFee(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromFee[account];
    }

    function setBuyFees(uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) external onlyOwner {
        require(taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee <= 30, "Fee above 30% not allowed");
        _buyTaxFee = taxFee;
        _buyLiquidityFee = liquidityFee;
        _buyMarketingFee = marketingFee;
        _buyBurnFee = burnFee;
    }

    function setSellFees(uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) external onlyOwner {
        require(taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee <= 30, "Fee above 30% not allowed");
        _sellTaxFee = taxFee;
        _sellLiquidityFee = liquidityFee;
        _sellMarketingFee = marketingFee;
        _sellBurnFee = burnFee;
    }

    function setTransferFees(uint256 taxFee, uint256 liquidityFee, uint256 marketingFee, uint256 burnFee) external onlyOwner {
        require(taxFee + liquidityFee + marketingFee + burnFee <= 30, "Fee above 30% not allowed");
        _transferTaxFee = taxFee;
        _transferLiquidityFee = liquidityFee;
        _transferMarketingFee = marketingFee;
        _transferBurnFee = burnFee;
    }

    function setMarketingWallet(address wallet) external onlyOwner {
        _marketingWallet = wallet;
    }

    function setMaxTx(uint256 maxTxPercent) external onlyOwner {
        _maxTxAmount = _tTotal * maxTxPercent / 100;
    }

    function setMaxWalletSize(uint256 maxWalletPercent) external onlyOwner {
        _maxWalletSize = _tTotal * maxWalletPercent / 100;
    }

    function setMinLpTokens(uint256 minLpTokens) external onlyOwner {
        _minLpTokens = minLpTokens;
    }

    function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(bool enabled) public onlyOwner {
        _swapAndLiquifyEnabled = enabled;
        emit SwapAndLiquifyEnabledUpdated(enabled);
    }

    function allowTrading() public onlyOwner {
        _tradingOpen = true;
        _cooldownEnabled = true;
    }

    function canTrade() public view returns (bool) {
        return _tradingOpen;
    }

    function swapAndLiquifyEnabled() public view returns (bool) {
        return _swapAndLiquifyEnabled;
    }

    function maxTx() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxTxAmount;
    }

    function maxWalletSize() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxWalletSize;
    }

    function marketingWallet() public view returns (address) {
        return _marketingWallet;
    }

    function automatedMarketMakerPairs(address pair) public view returns (bool) {
        return _automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair];
    }

    function setAMM(address pair, bool value) public onlyOwner {
        _automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair] = value;
    }

    function excludeFromMaxTx(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[account] = true;
    }

    function includeInMaxTx(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxTx[account] = false;
    }

    function excludeFromMaxWallet(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account] = true;
    }

    function includeInMaxWallet(address account) public onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account] = false;
    }

    function isExcludedFromMaxWallet(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isExcludedFromMaxWallet[account];
    }

    function uniswapV2Router() public view returns (IUniswapV2Router01) {
        return uniswapV2Router;
    }

    function uniswapPair() public view returns (address) {
        return uniswapV2Pair;
    }

    function _rTotal() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _rTotal;
    }

    function _tTotal() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _tTotal;
    }

    function _taxFeeBuy() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _buyTaxFee;
    }

    function _liquidityFeeBuy() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _buyLiquidityFee;
    }

    function _marketingFeeBuy() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _buyMarketingFee;
    }

    function _burnFeeBuy() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _buyBurnFee;
    }

    function _taxFeeSell() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _sellTaxFee;
    }

    function _liquidityFeeSell() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _sellLiquidityFee;
    }

    function _marketingFeeSell() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _sellMarketingFee;
    }

    function _burnFeeSell() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _sellBurnFee;
    }

    function _taxFeeTransfer() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _transferTaxFee;
    }

    function _liquidityFeeTransfer() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _transferLiquidityFee;
    }

    function _marketingFeeTransfer() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _transferMarketingFee;
    }

    function _burnFeeTransfer() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _transferBurnFee;
    }

    function _previousMarketingFee() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _previousMarketingFee;
    }

    function _excluded(uint256 index) public view returns (address) {
        return _excluded[index];
    }

    function _feeDenominator() public pure returns (uint256) {
        return 100;
    }

    function clearStuckBalance(address recipient) external onlyOwner {
        payable(recipient).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }

    function claimTokens() external onlyOwner {
        _transfer(address(this), msg.sender, balanceOf(address(this)));
    }

    function claimOtherTokens(address tokenAddress, address to) external onlyOwner {
        IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(to, IERC20(tokenAddress).balanceOf(address(this)));
    }

    function burnWallet() public pure returns (address) {
        return address(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD);
    }

    function pauseTrading() external onlyOwner {
        _tradingOpen = false;
    }

    function removeB(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isExcludedFromFee[account] = false;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}
