        require(quantity == 1, "You can mint only 1 NFT per call");
        require(_verifyProof(proof, msg.sender), "Crossmint is allowed for only Elegan Collection.");
        require(msg.value >= _getPrice(1), "Ether sent is not correct.");
        require(_totalSupplyStandard < MAX_SUPPLY_STANDARD, "Max supply reached for this phase.");
        _totalSupplyStandard += quantity;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = totalSupply() + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
        }
        _distributeFunds();
    }
    
    function mintPUBLIC(uint256 collectionId) public payable {
        require(_salePhase == _PHASE_PUBLIC, "PUBLIC_SALES is not active");
        if (collectionId == 3) {
            _getPriceRate(1);
            require(msg.value >= _getPrice(1), "Ether sent is not correct.");
            require(_totalSupplyStandard < MAX_SUPPLY_STANDARD, "Max supply reached for this phase.");
            _totalSupplyStandard += 1;
            uint256 tokenId = totalSupply() + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
        } else if (collectionId == 2) {
            _getPriceRate(2);
            require(msg.value >= _getPrice(2), "Ether sent is not correct.");
            require(_totalSupplyPremium < MAX_SUPPLY_PREMIUM, "Max supply reached for this phase.");
            _totalSupplyPremium += 1;
            uint256 tokenId = totalSupply() + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
        } else if (collectionId == 1) {
            _getPriceRate(3);
            require(msg.value >= _getPrice(3), "Ether sent is not correct.");
            require(_totalSupplyLuxury < MAX_SUPPLY_LUXURY, "Max supply reached for this phase.");
            _totalSupplyLuxury += 1;
            uint256 tokenId = totalSupply() + 1;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
        } else {
            revert("Invalid collection ID");
        }
        _distributeFunds();
    }
    
    function _getPriceRate(uint256 collectionId) internal view returns (uint256) {
        (, int256 price, , , ) = AggregatorV3Interface(address(0x0d)).latestRoundData();
        uint256 ethPrice = uint256(price);
        uint256 targetPrice = 1000 * 10**18;
        uint256 decimals = 10**18;
        uint256 rate = (targetPrice * decimals) / ethPrice;
        return rate;
    }
    
    function _getPrice(uint256 collectionId) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (collectionId == 1) return priceStandard;
        if (collectionId == 2) return pricePremium;
        if (collectionId == 3) return priceLuxury;
        return 0;
    }
    
    function _verifyProof(bytes32[] calldata proof, address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account));
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            leaf = proof[i] < leaf ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proof[i], leaf)) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(leaf, proof[i]));
        }
        return leaf == merkleRoot;
    }
    
    function _distributeFunds() internal {
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        if (balance > 0) {
            address ownerAddr = owner();
            if (ownerAddr != address(0)) {
                (bool success, ) = ownerAddr.call{value: balance * 200 / 10000}("");
                require(success, "Transfer failed");
            }
            address investorAddr = investor;
            if (investorAddr != address(0)) {
                (bool success, ) = investorAddr.call{value: balance * 10 / 10000}("");
                require(success, "Transfer failed");
            }
            address royaltyRecipient = address(0x1c);
            if (royaltyRecipient != address(0)) {
                (bool success, ) = royaltyRecipient.call{value: balance * 200 / 10000}("");
                require(success, "Transfer failed");
            }
            address anotherRecipient = address(0x1d);
            if (anotherRecipient != address(0)) {
                (bool success, ) = anotherRecipient.call{value: balance * 50 / 10000}("");
                require(success, "Transfer failed");
            }
        }
    }
    
    function setPriceStandard(uint256 _price) public onlyOwner {
        priceStandard = _price;
    }
    
    function setPricePremium(uint256 _price) public onlyOwner {
        pricePremium = _price;
    }
    
    function setPriceLuxury(uint256 _price) public onlyOwner {
        priceLuxury = _price;
    }
    
    function setMerkleRoot(bytes32 _merkleRoot) public onlyOwner {
        merkleRoot = _merkleRoot;
    }
    
    function setInvestor(address _investor) public onlyOwner {
        investor = _investor;
    }
    
    function setTokenURI(uint256 tokenId, uint256 phase) public onlyOwner {
        _tokenPhase[tokenId] = phase;
    }
    
    function withdraw() public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }
    
    function _withdraw(address recipient, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = recipient.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }
    
    function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice) public view returns (address receiver, uint256 royaltyAmount) {
        receiver = ownerOf(tokenId);
        uint256 royaltyBps = _royaltyBps[receiver];
        require(salePrice <= 10000, "ERC2981: royalty fee will exceed salePrice");
        require(receiver != address(0), "ERC2981: Invalid parameters");
        royaltyAmount = (salePrice * royaltyBps) / 10000;
    }
    
    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + value % 10));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

        require(_keysCount != 0, "NO_KEYS");
        require(_pubkeys.length == _keysCount * PUBKEY_LENGTH, "INVALID_LENGTH");
        require(_signatures.length == _keysCount * SIGNATURE_LENGTH, "INVALID_LENGTH");
        uint256 keysData = _getStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2));
        uint64 totalKeys = uint64(keysData >> 128);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _keysCount; ++i) {
            bytes pubkey = _extractBytes(_pubkeys, i * PUBKEY_LENGTH, PUBKEY_LENGTH);
            bytes signature = _extractBytes(_signatures, i * SIGNATURE_LENGTH, SIGNATURE_LENGTH);
            _setSigningKey(_operatorId, totalKeys + i, pubkey, signature);
        }
        keysData = (keysData & 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff0000000000000000) | (uint256(totalKeys + uint64(_keysCount)) << 128);
        _setStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2), keysData);
        _increaseKeysOpIndex();
    }

    function _removeSigningKey(uint256 _operatorId, uint256 _keyIndex) internal {
        require(_operatorId < getTotalNodeOperatorsCount(), "NODE_OPERATOR_NOT_FOUND");
        uint256 keysData = _getStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2));
        uint64 totalKeys = uint64(keysData >> 128);
        uint64 usedKeys = uint64(keysData >> 64);
        require(_keyIndex < totalKeys, "KEY_NOT_FOUND");
        require(_keyIndex >= usedKeys, "KEY_WAS_USED");
        (bytes pubkey, ) = _getSigningKey(_operatorId, _keyIndex);
        if (_keyIndex < totalKeys - 1) {
            (bytes lastPubkey, bytes lastSignature) = _getSigningKey(_operatorId, totalKeys - 1);
            _setSigningKey(_operatorId, _keyIndex, lastPubkey, lastSignature);
        }
        _clearSigningKey(_operatorId, totalKeys - 1);
        keysData = (keysData & 0xffffffffffffffff0000000000000000ffffffffffffffff) | (uint256(totalKeys - 1) << 128);
        _setStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2), keysData);
        emit SigningKeyRemoved(_operatorId, pubkey);
        _increaseKeysOpIndex();
    }

    function _removeSigningKeys(uint256 _operatorId, uint256 _keysCount, uint256 _fromIndex) internal {
        require(_operatorId < getTotalNodeOperatorsCount(), "NODE_OPERATOR_NOT_FOUND");
        uint256 keysData = _getStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2));
        uint64 totalKeys = uint64(keysData >> 128);
        uint64 usedKeys = uint64(keysData >> 64);
        require(_fromIndex < totalKeys, "KEY_NOT_FOUND");
        require(_fromIndex >= usedKeys, "KEY_WAS_USED");
        require(_keysCount <= totalKeys - _fromIndex, "KEYS_COUNT_EXCEEDED");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _keysCount; ++i) {
            _clearSigningKey(_operatorId, _fromIndex + i);
        }
        keysData = (keysData & 0xffffffffffffffff0000000000000000ffffffffffffffff) | (uint256(totalKeys - uint64(_keysCount)) << 128);
        _setStorageUint256(_getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId, 2), keysData);
        _increaseKeysOpIndex();
    }

    function _getSigningKey(uint256 _operatorId, uint256 _keyIndex) internal view returns (bytes pubkey, bytes signature) {
        bytes32 key = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(SIGNING_KEYS_MAPPING_NAME_PREFIX, _operatorId, _keyIndex));
        uint256 data0 = _getStorageUint256(key);
        uint256 data1 = _getStorageUint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(key, 1)));
        pubkey = abi.encodePacked(uint384(data0));
        signature = abi.encodePacked(uint384(data1));
    }

    function _setSigningKey(uint256 _operatorId, uint256 _keyIndex, bytes _pubkey, bytes _signature) internal {
        bytes32 key = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(SIGNING_KEYS_MAPPING_NAME_PREFIX, _operatorId, _keyIndex));
        _setStorageUint256(key, uint256(_pubkey));
        _setStorageUint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(key, 1)), uint256(_signature));
    }

    function _clearSigningKey(uint256 _operatorId, uint256 _keyIndex) internal {
        bytes32 key = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(SIGNING_KEYS_MAPPING_NAME_PREFIX, _operatorId, _keyIndex));
        _setStorageUint256(key, 0);
        _setStorageUint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(key, 1)), 0);
    }

    function _increaseKeysOpIndex() internal {
        uint256 index = getKeysOpIndex() + 1;
        _setStorageUint256(KEYS_OP_INDEX_STORAGE_POSITION, index);
        emit KeysOpIndexSet(index);
    }

    function _isValidNodeOperatorManager(uint256 _operatorId, address _sender) internal view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 opKey = _getNodeOperatorKey(_operatorId);
        uint256 packed = _getStorageUint256(opKey);
        address rewardAddress = address(packed >> 160);
        return rewardAddress == _sender;
    }

    function _getLido() internal view returns (address) {
        return _getStorageUint256(LIDO_STORAGE_POSITION);
    }

    function _getRecoveryVault() internal view returns (address) {
        return _kernel.getRecoveryVault();
    }

    function _tokenBalance(address _token) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _token.balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function _arr(uint256 _a) internal pure returns (uint256[] memory result) {
        result = new uint256[](1);
        result[0] = _a;
    }

    function _compareStrings(string _a, string _b) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_a)) == keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_b));
    }

    function _extractBytes(bytes _data, uint256 _offset, uint256 _length) internal pure returns (bytes) {
        bytes memory result = new bytes(_length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _length; ++i) {
            result[i] = _data[_offset + i];
        }
        return result;
    }
}

interface IKernel {
    function canPerform(address _sender, address _target, bytes32 _role, uint256[] memory _params) external view returns (bool);
    function getApp(bytes32 _appId, bytes32 _namespace) external view returns (address);
    function getEVMScriptExecutor(bytes _script) external view returns (address);
    function getEVMScriptRegistry() external view returns (address);
    function getRecoveryVault() external view returns (address);
}

library Storage {
    function storageLoad(bytes32 _key) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return uint256(_key.sload());
    }

    function storageStore(bytes32 _key, uint256 _value) internal {
        _key.sstore(_value);
    }

    function storageLoadBytes(bytes32 _key) internal view returns (bytes) {
        uint256 len = storageLoad(_key);
        bytes memory result = new bytes(len);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            result[i] = byte(storageStore(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_key, i)), 0));
        }
        return result;
    }

    function storageStoreBytes(bytes32 _key, bytes _value) internal {
        storageStore(_key, _value.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _value.length; ++i) {
            storageStore(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_key, i)), uint256(_value[i]));
        }
    }
}

library SafeERC20 {
    function safeTransfer(address _token, address _to, uint256 _amount) internal {
        bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, _to, _amount);
        require(_token.call(data), "SAFE_ERC20_TRANSFER_FAILED");
    }
}

    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);

    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        _checkRole(role, _msgSender());
        _;
    }

    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view virtual override returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role].members[account];
    }

    function _checkRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal view virtual {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            revert(string(abi.encodePacked("AccessControl: account ", Strings.toHexString(account), " is missing role ", Strings.toHexString(uint256(role), 32))));
        }
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view virtual override returns (bytes32) {
        return _roles[role].adminRole;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual override {
        require(account == _msgSender(), "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _setupRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function _setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal virtual {
        bytes32 previousAdminRole = getRoleAdmin(role);
        _roles[role].adminRole = adminRole;
        emit RoleAdminChanged(role, previousAdminRole, adminRole);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role].members[account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, _msgSender());
        }
    }
}

library Strings {
    bytes16 private constant _HEX_SYMBOLS = "0123456789abcdef";
    uint8 private constant _ADDRESS_LENGTH = 20;

    function toHexString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0x00";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 length = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            length++;
            temp >>= 8;
        }
        return toHexString(value, length);
    }

    function toHexString(uint256 value, uint256 length) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(2 * length + 2);
        buffer[0] = "0";
        buffer[1] = "x";
        for (uint256 i = 2 * length + 1; i > 1; --i) {
            buffer[i] = _HEX_SYMBOLS[value & 0xf];
            value >>= 4;
        }
        require(value == 0, "Strings: hex length insufficient");
        return string(buffer);
    }

    function toHexString(address addr) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        return toHexString(uint256(uint160(addr)), _ADDRESS_LENGTH);
    }
}

        _claim(user, tokens);
    }

    function _claim(address user, address[] calldata tokens) internal {
        uint256 totalPending = userBaseClaimable[user];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage user = userInfo[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            uint256 pending = user.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - user.rewardDebt;
            totalPending += pending;

            user.rewardDebt = user.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12;
        }

        userBaseClaimable[user] = 0;
        _transferReward(user, totalPending);
    }

    function claimAll(address user) external onlyWhitelisted {
        _claimAll(user);
    }

    function _claimAll(address user) internal {
        _claim(user, registeredTokens);
    }

    function claimBounty(address user, bool dq) external onlyBountyManager {
        if (dq) {
            _disqualify(user);
        } else {
            _claimAll(user);
        }
    }

    function _disqualify(address user) internal {
        uint256 totalPending = userBaseClaimable[user];

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < registeredTokens.length; i++) {
            address token = registeredTokens[i];
            PoolInfo storage pool = poolInfo[token];
            UserInfo storage user = userInfo[token][user];

            updatePool(token);

            uint256 pending = user.amount * pool.accRewardPerShare / 1e12 - user.rewardDebt;
            totalPending += pending;

            user.amount = 0;
            user.rewardDebt = 0;
        }

        userBaseClaimable[user] = 0;
        emit Disqualified(user);
    }

    function _transferReward(address user, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount > 0) {
            IERC20(address(rdntToken)).transfer(user, amount);
        }
    }

    function batchUpdateAllocPoint(address[] calldata tokens, uint256[] calldata allocPoints) external onlyPoolConfigurator {
        require(tokens.length == allocPoints.length, "Length mismatch");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            poolInfo[tokens[i]].allocPoint = allocPoints[i];
        }
    }

    function userInfo(address token, address user) external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, address) {
        UserInfo storage info = userInfo[token][user];
        return (info.amount, info.rewardDebt, info.lastClaimTime, info.user);
    }

    function endRewardTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return endingTime;
    }

    function whitelistActive() external view returns (bool) {
        return whitelistActive;
    }

    function eligibilityExempt(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return eligibilityExempt[user];
    }

    function emissionSchedule(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        return (emissionSchedule[index].startTime, emissionSchedule[index].rewardsPerSecond);
    }

    function registeredTokens(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return registeredTokens[index];
    }

    function whitelist(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return whitelist[user];
    }

    function mfd() external view returns (address) {
        return address(mfd);
    }

    function bountyManager() external view returns (address) {
        return address(bountyManager);
    }

    function lastRPS() external view returns (uint256) {
        return lastRPS;
    }

    function accountedRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return accountedRewards;
    }

    function userBaseClaimable(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return userBaseClaimable[user];
    }

    function poolConfigurator() external view returns (address) {
        return poolConfigurator;
    }

    function authorizedContracts(address contract_) external view returns (bool) {
        return authorizedContracts[contract_];
    }

    function rewardsPerSecond() external view returns (uint256) {
        return getRewardsPerSecond();
    }

    function depositedRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return depositedRewards;
    }

    function startTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return startTime;
    }

    function endingTime() external view returns (uint256) {
        return endingTime;
    }

    function eligibleDataProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return address(eligibleDataProvider);
    }

    function lastAllPoolUpdate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return lastAllPoolUpdate;
    }
}

contract PaymentSplitter {
    uint256 private _totalShares;
    uint256 private _totalReleased;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _shares;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _released;
    address[] private _payees;

    event PayeeAdded(address account, uint256 shares);
    event PaymentReleased(address to, uint256 amount);
    event ERC20PaymentReleased(address token, address to, uint256 amount);
    event PaymentReceived(address from, uint256 amount);

    constructor(address[] memory payees, uint256[] memory shares_) payable {
        require(payees.length == shares_.length, "PaymentSplitter: payees and shares length mismatch");
        require(payees.length > 0, "PaymentSplitter: no payees");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < payees.length; i++) {
            _addPayee(payees[i], shares_[i]);
        }
    }

    function receivePayment() external payable {
        emit PaymentReceived(msg.sender, msg.value);
    }

    function totalShares() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalShares;
    }

    function totalReleased() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalReleased;
    }

    function totalReleased(address token) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _released[token];
    }

    function shares(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _shares[account];
    }

    function released(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _released[account];
    }

    function released(address token, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _released[account];
    }

    function payee(uint256 index) public view returns (address) {
        return _payees[index];
    }

    function payeesLength() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _payees.length;
    }

    function releasable(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 totalReceived = address(this).balance + _totalReleased;
        return _pendingPayment(account, totalReceived, _released[account]);
    }

    function releasable(address token, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 totalReceived = _released[token];
        return _pendingPayment(account, totalReceived, _released[account]);
    }

    function release(address payable account) public virtual {
        require(_shares[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(account);
        require(payment != 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");
        _released[account] += payment;
        _totalReleased += payment;
        Address.sendValue(account, payment);
        emit PaymentReleased(account, payment);
    }

    function release(address token, address account) public virtual {
        require(_shares[account] > 0, "PaymentSplitter: account has no shares");
        uint256 payment = releasable(token, account);
        require(payment != 0, "PaymentSplitter: account is not due payment");
        _released[account] += payment;
        emit ERC20PaymentReleased(token, account, payment);
    }

    function releaseAll(address account) public {
        release(account);
    }

    function releaseAll() public {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _payees.length; i++) {
            release(payable(_payees[i]));
        }
    }

    function _pendingPayment(address account, uint256 totalReceived, uint256 alreadyReleased) private view returns (uint256) {
        return (totalReceived * _shares[account]) / _totalShares - alreadyReleased;
    }

    function _addPayee(address account, uint256 shares_) private {
        require(account != address(0), "PaymentSplitter: account is the zero address");
        require(shares_ > 0, "PaymentSplitter: shares are 0");
        require(_shares[account] == 0, "PaymentSplitter: account already has shares");
        _payees.push(account);
        _shares[account] = shares_;
        _totalShares += shares_;
        emit PayeeAdded(account, shares_);
    }
}

library Address {
    function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return account.code.length > 0;
    }

    function sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Address: insufficient balance");
        (bool success, ) = recipient.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");
    }

    function functionCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        return functionCallWithValue(target, data, 0, "Address: low-level call failed");
    }

    function functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, uint256 value, string memory errorMessage) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        require(address(this).balance >= value, "Address: insufficient balance for call");
        require(isContract(target), "Address: call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: value}(data);
        return verifyCallResult(success, returndata, errorMessage);
    }

    function verifyCallResult(bool success, bytes memory returndata, string memory errorMessage) internal pure returns (bytes memory) {
        if (success) {
            return returndata;
        } else {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    let returndata_size := mload(returndata)
                    revert(add(32, returndata), returndata_size)
                }
            } else {
                revert(errorMessage);
            }
        }
    }
}

library Strings {
    function toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

        return _balances[owner];
    }

        address owner = _ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return owner;
    }

    function _ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) internal view virtual returns (address) {
        return _owners[tokenId];
    }

    function name() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        string memory baseURI = _baseURI();
        return bytes(baseURI).length > 0 ? string(abi.encodePacked(baseURI, Strings.toString(tokenId), _suffix)) : "";

        return _baseURI;
    }

        address owner = ERC721.ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != owner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(
            msg.sender == owner || isApprovedForAll(owner, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all"
        );
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: approved query for nonexistent token");

        _isAdmin[account] = isAdmin_;
    }

    function isAdmin(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isAdmin[account];
    }

    function addToWhitelist(uint8 stage_, address[] memory accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _mintedPerAddress[accounts[i]] = 0;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(uint8 stage_, address[] memory accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _mintedPerAddress[accounts[i]] = 0;
        }
    }

    function isWhitelisted(uint8 stage_, address account, bytes32[] memory proof) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account));
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            leaf = proof[i] < leaf ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proof[i], leaf)) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(leaf, proof[i]));
        }
        return leaf == _merkleRoot;
    }

    function publicMint(uint256 quantity) external payable {
        require(_stage == 1, "Current stage is not enabled");
        require(quantity <= _balanceLimit, "Exceeds balance limit");
        require(msg.value >= _price * quantity, "Insufficient payment");
        require(tx.origin == msg.sender, "No bots");
        _mintLoop(quantity, msg.sender);
    }

    function multiStageMint(uint256 quantity, bytes32[] memory proof, uint8 stage_) external payable {
        require(_stage == stage_, "Current stage is not enabled");
        require(quantity <= _balanceLimit, "Exceeds balance limit");
        require(isWhitelisted(stage_, msg.sender, proof), "Not whitelisted");
        require(msg.value >= _price * quantity, "Insufficient payment");
        _mintLoop(quantity, msg.sender);
    }

    function adminMint(address[] memory to, uint256[] memory quantities) external {
        require(_isAdmin[msg.sender], "Admin mint: bad request");
        require(to.length == quantities.length, "Arrays length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
            _mintLoop(quantities[i], to[i]);
        }
    }

    function _mintLoop(uint256 quantity, address to) internal {
        require(totalSupply() + quantity <= _maxSupply, "Exceeds max supply");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < quantity; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _currentIndex + i;
            _safeMint(to, tokenId);
            _mintedPerAddress[to]++;
        }
        _currentIndex += quantity;
    }

    function explicitOwnershipOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address owner) {
        return ownerOf(tokenId);
    }

    function explicitOwnershipsOf(uint256[] memory tokenIds) external view returns (address[] memory owners) {
        owners = new address[](tokenIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            owners[i] = ownerOf(tokenIds[i]);
        }
    }

    function tokensOfOwner(address owner) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 balance = balanceOf(owner);
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](balance);
        uint256 index = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _currentIndex; i++) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                tokens[index++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function tokensOfOwnerIn(address owner, uint256 start, uint256 end) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory tokens = new uint256[](balanceOf(owner));
        uint256 index = 0;
        for (uint256 i = start; i < end && i < _currentIndex; i++) {
            if (_ownerOf(i) == owner) {
                tokens[index++] = i;
            }
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function setPrefix(string memory prefix_) external onlyOwner {
        _baseURI = prefix_;
    }

    function setSuffix(string memory suffix_) external onlyOwner {
        _suffix = suffix_;
    }

    function prefix() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _baseURI;
    }

    function suffix() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _suffix;
    }

    function remainingBalance(uint8 stage_, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balanceLimit - _mintedPerAddress[account];
    }

    function currentBalance(uint8 stage_, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _mintedPerAddress[account];
    }

    function released(address token, address account) public view override(PaymentSplitter) returns (uint256) {
        return super.released(token, account);
    }

    function release(address token, address account) public override(PaymentSplitter) {
        super.release(token, account);
    }

    function releasable(address token, address account) public view override(PaymentSplitter) returns (uint256) {
        return super.releable(token, account);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.6.12;

/**
 * @title LendingPool
 * @dev Aave V1 LendingPool main contract.
 * Manages deposits, borrows, repays, flash loans, and liquidations.
 */
contract LendingPool {
    // --- Structs ---

    struct ReserveData {
        uint256 totalStableDebt;
        uint256 totalVariableDebt;
        uint256 currentLiquidityRate;
        uint256 currentVariableBorrowRate;
        uint256 currentStableBorrowRate;
        uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp;
        uint256 averageStableBorrowRate;
        uint256 liquidityIndex;
        uint256 variableBorrowIndex;
        address aTokenAddress;
        uint40 id;
    }

    struct UserReserveData {
        uint256 currentStableDebt;
        uint256 currentVariableDebt;
        uint256 principalStableDebt;
        uint256 stableBorrowRate;
        uint256 originationFee;
        uint256 variableBorrowIndex;
        uint40 lastUpdateTimestamp;
        bool useAsCollateral;
    }

    struct ReserveConfigurationData {
        uint256 ltv;
        uint256 liquidationThreshold;
        uint256 liquidationBonus;
        uint256 interestRateStrategyAddress;
        uint256 usageAsCollateralEnabled;
        uint256 borrowingEnabled;
        uint256 stableBorrowRateEnabled;
        uint256 isActive;
        uint256 isFrozen;
    }

    // --- Events ---

    event Deposit(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint16 indexed referral,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event RedeemUnderlying(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event Borrow(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 borrowRateMode,
        uint256 borrowRate,
        uint256 originationFee,
        uint256 borrowBalanceIncrease,
        uint16 indexed referral,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event Repay(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        address indexed repayer,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 fee,
        uint256 borrowBalanceIncrease,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event Swap(
        address indexed reserve,
        address indexed user,
        uint256 rateMode,
        uint256 newRate,
        uint256 borrowBalanceIncrease,
        uint256 timestamp
    );
    event ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);
    event FlashLoan(
        address indexed target,
        address indexed reserve,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 fee,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    // --- Errors ---

    string constant ERROR_REENTRANCY = "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call";
    string constant ERROR_AMOUNT_ZERO = "Amount must be greater than 0";
    string constant ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_LIQUIDITY = "There is not enough liquidity available to borrow";
    string constant ERROR_BORROW_MODE_INVALID = "Invalid interest rate mode selected";
    string constant ERROR_BORROW_TOO_SMALL = "The amount to borrow is too small";
    string constant ERROR_NO_BORROW = "User does not have any borrow for this reserve";
    string constant ERROR_DEPOSIT_ALREADY_COLLATERAL = "User deposit is already being used as collateral";
    string constant ERROR_RESERVE_NOT_ENABLED = "Reserve is not enabled for borrowing";
    string constant ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_COLLATERAL = "There is not enough collateral to cover a new borrow";
    string constant ERROR_CALLER_NOT_POOL = "The caller of this function can only be the LendingPool";
    string constant ERROR_LIQUIDATION_CALL_FAILED = "Liquidation call failed";
    string constant ERROR_CALLER_NOT_AAVE = "To execute this function, caller must be the LendingPool";
    string constant ERROR_RESERVE_INACTIVE = "Action requires an active reserve";
    string constant ERROR_RESERVE_FROZEN = "Action requires an unfrozen reserve";
    string constant ERROR_NOT_CONTRACT = "Target is not a contract";
    string constant ERROR_TRANSFER_NOT_ALLOWED = "Transfer cannot be performed";
    string constant ERROR_BORROW_STABLE_NOT_ALLOWED = "User cannot borrow the selected amount with a stable rate";
    string constant ERROR_NO_LIQUIDITY_DEPOSIT = "User does not have any liquidity deposited";
    string constant ERROR_BORROW_TOO_MUCH = "User is trying to borrow too much liquidity at a stable rate";
    string constant ERROR_STABLE_BORROW_VAR = "The user borrow is variable and cannot be rebalanced";
    string constant ERROR_REPAY_AMOUNT_INVALID = "Invalid msg.value for the repayment";
    string constant ERROR_BALANCE_NOT_ZERO = "The actual balance of the protocol is inconsistent";
    string constant ERROR_USER_NO_BORROW_PENDING = "User does not have any borrow pending";
    string constant ERROR_USER_CANNOT_BORROW_STABLE = "User cannot borrow the selected amount at stable";
    string constant ERROR_REPAY_EXPLICIT_AMOUNT = "To repay on behalf of a user an explicit amount to repay is needed.";
    string constant ERROR_ACTION_UNFREEZE = "Action requires an unfreeze reserve";
    string constant ERROR_USER_ALREADY_BORROWING = "User is already borrowing and cannot borrow more with a stable rate";
    string constant ERROR_CONTRACT_NOT_INITIALIZED = "Contract instance has already been initialized";
    string constant ERROR_USER_CANNOT_BORROW_SELECTED = "User cannot borrow the selected amount with a stable rate";
    string constant ERROR_USER_NO_BORROW_PROGRESS = "User does not have a borrow in progress on this reserve";
    string constant ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_LIQUIDITY_REDEEM = "There is not enough liquidity available in the reserve";
    string constant ERROR_REQUESTED_AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL = "The requested amount is too small or a flash loan";
    string constant ERROR_CALLER_NOT_LENDING_POOL = "The caller of this function must be the LendingPool";

    // --- State Variables ---

    uint256 private _reentrancyStatus;
    address public addressesProvider;
    address public core;
    address public dataProvider;
    address public parametersProvider;
    address public liquidationManager;
    address public tokenDistributor;
    address public feeProvider;
    address public lendingPool;
    address public lendingPoolCore;
    address public lendingPoolParametersProvider;
    address public lendingPoolLiquidationManager;
    address public lendingPoolDataProvider;

    // --- Modifiers ---

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_reentrancyStatus == 0, ERROR_REENTRANCY);
        _reentrancyStatus = 1;
        _;
        _reentrancyStatus = 0;
    }

    modifier onlyLendingPool() {
        require(msg.sender == lendingPool, ERROR_CALLER_NOT_POOL);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyLendingPoolCore() {
        require(msg.sender == lendingPoolCore, ERROR_CALLER_NOT_POOL);
        _;
    }

    // --- Constructor & Initialization ---

    constructor() public {
        _reentrancyStatus = 0;
    }

    function initialize(address _addressesProvider) external {
        require(addressesProvider == address(0), ERROR_CONTRACT_NOT_INITIALIZED);
        addressesProvider = _addressesProvider;
        _refreshConfig();
    }

    function _refreshConfig() internal {
        core = _getLendingPoolCore();
        dataProvider = _getLendingPoolDataProvider();
        parametersProvider = _getLendingPoolParametersProvider();
        liquidationManager = _getLendingPoolLiquidationManager();
        tokenDistributor = _getTokenDistributor();
        feeProvider = _getFeeProvider();
        lendingPool = _getLendingPool();
        lendingPoolCore = core;
        lendingPoolDataProvider = dataProvider;
        lendingPoolParametersProvider = parametersProvider;
        lendingPoolLiquidationManager = liquidationManager;
    }

    // --- External View Functions ---

    function LENDINGPOOL_REVISION() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 5;
    }

    function getReserves() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return ILendingPoolCore(core).getReserves();
    }

    function getReserveData(address _reserve)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 totalStableDebt,
            uint256 totalVariableDebt,
            uint256 currentLiquidityRate,
            uint256 currentVariableBorrowRate,
            uint256 currentStableBorrowRate,
            uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp,
            uint256 averageStableBorrowRate,
            uint256 liquidityIndex,
            uint256 variableBorrowIndex,
            address aTokenAddress,
            uint40 id
        )
    {
        return ILendingPoolCore(core).getReserveData(_reserve);
    }

    function getReserveConfigurationData(address _reserve)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 ltv,
            uint256 liquidationThreshold,
            uint256 liquidationBonus,
            uint256 interestRateStrategyAddress,
            uint256 usageAsCollateralEnabled,
            uint256 borrowingEnabled,
            uint256 stableBorrowRateEnabled,
            uint256 isActive,
            uint256 isFrozen
        )
    {
        return ILendingPoolCore(core).getReserveConfigurationData(_reserve);
    }

    function getUserReserveData(address _reserve, address _user)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 currentStableDebt,
            uint256 currentVariableDebt,
            uint256 principalStableDebt,
            uint256 stableBorrowRate,
            uint256 originationFee,
            uint256 variableBorrowIndex,
            uint40 lastUpdateTimestamp,
            bool useAsCollateral
        )
    {
        return ILendingPoolCore(core).getUserReserveData(_reserve, _user);
    }

    function getUserAccountData(address _user)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 totalLiquidityETH,
            uint256 totalCollateralETH,
            uint256 totalBorrowsETH,
            uint256 totalFeesETH,
            uint256 currentLtv,
            uint256 currentLiquidationThreshold,
            uint256 healthFactor
        )
    {
        return ILendingPoolCore(core).getUserAccountData(_user);
    }

    function addressesProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return addressesProvider;
    }

    function core() external view returns (address) {
        return core;
    }

    function dataProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return dataProvider;
    }

    function parametersProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return parametersProvider;
    }

    function UINT_MAX_VALUE() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return uint256(-1);
    }

        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }

    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }

        require(b > 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return a / b;
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits--;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }

    }

        address pool = _getPool(params.tokenIn, params.tokenOut, params.fee);
        (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, params.recipient, params.amountIn, params.sqrtPriceLimitX96, true);
        amountOut = uint256(-amount1Delta);
    }

    function _exactOutputSingle(ExactOutputSingleParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        address pool = _getPool(params.tokenIn, params.tokenOut, params.fee);
        (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, params.recipient, -int256(params.amountOut), params.sqrtPriceLimitX96, false);
        amountIn = uint256(amount0Delta);
    }

    function _exactInput(ExactInputParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address tokenIn = params.tokenIn;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < params.path.length - 1; i++) {
            (address tokenOut, uint24 fee) = _decodePool(params.path[i]);
            address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee);
            (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, address(this), params.amountIn, 0, true);
            amountOut = uint256(-amount1Delta);
            tokenIn = tokenOut;
        }
        _transfer(tokenIn, params.recipient, amountOut);
    }

    function _exactOutput(ExactOutputParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        address tokenOut = params.tokenOut;
        for (uint256 i = params.path.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            (address tokenIn, uint24 fee) = _decodePool(params.path[i]);
            address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut, fee);
            (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = _swap(pool, address(this), -int256(params.amountOut), 0, false);
            amountIn = uint256(amount0Delta);
            tokenOut = tokenIn;
        }
        _transferFrom(tokenOut, msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
    }

    function _swap(address pool, address recipient, int256 amountSpecified, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96, bool exactInput) internal returns (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) {
        (amount0Delta, amount1Delta) = IUniswapV3Pool(pool).swap(recipient, amountSpecified, sqrtPriceLimitX96, exactInput, "");
    }

    function _mint(MintParams calldata params) internal returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
        (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1) = IPositionManager(positionManager).mint(
            params.token0,
            params.token1,
            params.fee,
            params.tickLower,
            params.tickUpper,
            params.amount0Desired,
            params.amount1Desired,
            params.amount0Min,
            params.amount1Min,
            params.recipient,
            params.deadline
        );
    }

    function _increaseLiquidity(IncreaseLiquidityParams calldata params) internal returns (uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
        (liquidity, amount0, amount1) = IPositionManager(positionManager).increaseLiquidity(
            params.tokenId,
            params.amount0Desired,
            params.amount1Desired,
            params.amount0Min,
            params.amount1Min,
            params.deadline
        );
    }

    function _getPool(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee) internal view returns (address pool) {
        (address token0, address token1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
        bytes32 salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(token0, token1, fee));
        assembly {
            pool := shr(96, mod(keccak256(add(0x60, salt), 0x55), 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF))
        }
    }

    function _decodePool(bytes calldata data) internal pure returns (address tokenOut, uint24 fee) {
        assembly {
            tokenOut := shr(96, calldataload(data.offset))
            fee := and(calldataload(add(data.offset, 0x14)), 0xffffff)
        }
    }

        address tokenIn;
        address tokenOut;
        uint24 fee;
        address recipient;
        uint256 amountIn;
        uint256 amountOutMinimum;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
    }

    struct ExactOutputSingleParams {
        address tokenIn;
        address tokenOut;
        uint24 fee;
        address recipient;
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 amountInMaximum;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
    }

    struct ExactInputParams {
        address tokenIn;
        bytes[] path;
        address recipient;
        uint256 amountIn;
        uint256 amountOutMinimum;
    }

    struct ExactOutputParams {
        address tokenOut;
        bytes[] path;
        address recipient;
        uint256 amountOut;
        uint256 amountInMaximum;
    }

    struct MintParams {

        address token1;

        int24 tickUpper;
        uint256 amount0Desired;
        uint256 amount1Desired;
        uint256 amount0Min;

        uint256 tokenId;
        uint256 amount0Desired;
        uint256 amount1Desired;
        uint256 amount0Min;
        uint256 amount1Min;
        uint256 deadline;
    }

        uint256 index = _delegatedToValidatorNow[address(uint160(validatorId))];
        _validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId][index] = nodeId;

        uint256 count = _delegatedToValidatorNow[address(uint160(validatorId))];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (_validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId][i] == nodeId) {
                _validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId][i] = _validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId][count - 1];
                delete _validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId][count - 1];
                _delegatedToValidatorNow[address(uint160(validatorId))]--;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

        uint256 index = _spaceToNodes[space];
        _spaceToNodesIndex[space][index] = nodeId;
        _spaceToNodes[space]++;
    }

    function _removeNodeFromSpace(uint8 space, uint256 nodeId) internal {
        uint256 count = _spaceToNodes[space];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            if (_spaceToNodesIndex[space][i] == nodeId) {
                _spaceToNodesIndex[space][i] = _spaceToNodesIndex[space][count - 1];
                delete _spaceToNodesIndex[space][count - 1];
                _spaceToNodes[space]--;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // AccessControl functions
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view override returns (bool) {

    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) public view override returns (address) {
        return _roleMembers[role][index];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view override returns (bytes32) {
        return DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE;
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public override onlyAdmin {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public override onlyAdmin {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public override {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _hasRole[role][account] = true;
            _roleMembers[role][_roleMemberCount[role]] = account;
            _roleMemberCount[role]++;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _hasRole[role][account] = false;
            uint256 count = _roleMemberCount[role];
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                if (_roleMembers[role][i] == account) {
                    _roleMembers[role][i] = _roleMembers[role][count - 1];
                    delete _roleMembers[role][count - 1];
                    _roleMemberCount[role]--;
                    break;
                }
            }
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract HabibiDistributor {
    // Events
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event Paused(address account);
    event Unpaused(address account);
    event TransferSingle(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 id, uint256 value);
    event TransferBatch(address indexed operator, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256[] ids, uint256[] values);
    event Claimed(uint256 indexed id, address indexed account, uint256 amount);
    event ClaimedMultiple(uint256[] ids, address indexed account, uint256[] amounts);

    // Constants
    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE = keccak256("HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE");

    // State variables
    address private _owner;
    bool private _paused;
    string private _contractURI;
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => bool)) private _roles;
    mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) private _roleAdmin;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _totalSupply;
    mapping(uint256 => MintPass) private _mintPasses;

    struct MintPass {
        uint256 totalSupply;
        uint256 maxSupply;
        uint256 startTime;
        uint256 endTime;
        uint256 startPrice;
        uint256 endPrice;
        uint256 priceDropInterval;
        uint256 maxPerTx;
        address redeemer;
        bool isDutchAuction;
        bool exists;
        string uri;
        bytes32 merkleRoot;
        mapping(address => uint256) claimed;
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!paused(), "Pausable: paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenPaused() {
        require(paused(), "Pausable: not paused");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRole(bytes32 role) {
        require(hasRole(role, msg.sender), "AccessControl: account is missing role");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
    }

    // ERC165
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || interfaceId == 0xd9b67a26 || interfaceId == 0x0e89341c;
    }

    // Ownable
    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    // Pausable
    function paused() public view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function pause() public onlyOwner whenNotPaused {
        _paused = true;
        emit Paused(msg.sender);
    }

    function unpause() public onlyOwner whenPaused {
        _paused = false;
        emit Unpaused(msg.sender);
    }

    // AccessControl
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) public view returns (bytes32) {
        return _roleAdmin[role];
    }

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) {
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function _setupRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        _grantRole(role, account);
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = true;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    // ERC1155
    function name() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function name_() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol_() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function uri(uint256 id) public view returns (string memory) {
        return _mintPasses[id].uri;
    }

    function contractURI() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _contractURI;
    }

    function _contractURI() public view returns (string memory) {
        return _contractURI;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC1155: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[id][account];
    }

    function balanceOfBatch(address[] memory accounts, uint256[] memory ids) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        require(accounts.length == ids.length, "ERC1155: accounts and ids length mismatch");
        uint256[] memory batchBalances = new uint256[](accounts.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
            batchBalances[i] = balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]);
        }
        return batchBalances;
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) public {
        require(msg.sender != operator, "ERC1155: setting approval status for self");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[account][operator];
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) public {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) public {
        require(ids.length == amounts.length, "ERC1155: ids and amounts length mismatch");
        require(from == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(from, msg.sender), "ERC1155: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        _safeBatchTransferFrom(from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
        _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, from, to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _safeBatchTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: transfer to the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; ++i) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
            require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: insufficient balance for transfer");
            _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
            _balances[id][to] += amount;
        }
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, from, to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, from, to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155Received(operator, from, id, amount, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    function _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(address operator, address from, address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) private {
        if (to.code.length > 0) {
            try IERC1155Receiver(to).onERC1155BatchReceived(operator, from, ids, amounts, data) returns (bytes4 response) {
                require(response == IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector, "ERC1155: ERC1155Receiver rejected tokens");
            } catch Error(string memory reason) {
                revert(reason);
            } catch {
                revert("ERC1155: transfer to non ERC1155Receiver implementer");
            }
        }
    }

    // Minting and Burning
    function _mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        _balances[id][to] += amount;
        _totalSupply[id] += amount;
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount);
        _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, id, amount, data);
    }

    function _mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC1155: mint to the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            _balances[ids[i]][to] += amounts[i];
            _totalSupply[ids[i]] += amounts[i];
        }
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts);
        _doSafeBatchTransferAcceptanceCheck(msg.sender, address(0), to, ids, amounts, data);
    }

    function _burn(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
        _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
        _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        emit TransferSingle(msg.sender, from, address(0), id, amount);
    }

    function _burnBatch(address from, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) internal {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC1155: burn from the zero address");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            uint256 id = ids[i];
            uint256 amount = amounts[i];
            uint256 fromBalance = _balances[id][from];
            require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC1155: burn amount exceeds balance");
            _balances[id][from] = fromBalance - amount;
            _totalSupply[id] -= amount;
        }
        emit TransferBatch(msg.sender, from, address(0), ids, amounts);
    }

    function burn(address account, uint256 id, uint256 value) public {
        require(account == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(account, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burn(account, id, value);
    }

    function burnBatch(address account, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory values) public {
        require(account == msg.sender || isApprovedForAll(account, msg.sender), "ERC1155: caller is not owner nor approved");
        _burnBatch(account, ids, values);
    }

    function totalSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply[id];
    }

    function exists(uint256 id) public view returns (bool) {
        return _mintPasses[id].exists;
    }

    // Admin functions
    function setOwner(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function setURI(string memory newUri) public onlyOwner {
        _contractURI = newUri;
    }

    function setContractURI(string memory newUri) public onlyOwner {
        _contractURI = newUri;
    }

    function demoteTeamMember(address member) public onlyOwner {
        _revokeRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE, member);
    }

    function promoteTeamMember(address member) public onlyOwner {
        _grantRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE, member);
    }

    // MintPass management
    function addMintPass(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 totalSupply_, uint256 maxSupply, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 startPrice, string memory uri_, address redeemer, uint256 maxPerTx) public onlyOwner {
        uint256 id = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(merkleRoot, totalSupply_, maxSupply, startTime, endTime, startPrice, uri_, redeemer, maxPerTx)));
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.totalSupply = totalSupply_;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.startPrice = startPrice;
        mp.endPrice = startPrice;
        mp.priceDropInterval = 0;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.redeemer = redeemer;
        mp.isDutchAuction = false;
        mp.exists = true;
        mp.uri = uri_;
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function editMintPass(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 id, uint256 totalSupply_, uint256 maxSupply, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, string memory uri_, address redeemer, bool isDutchAuction, uint256 maxPerTx) public onlyOwner {
        require(_mintPasses[id].exists, "MintPass does not exist");
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.totalSupply = totalSupply_;
        mp.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.uri = uri_;
        mp.redeemer = redeemer;
        mp.isDutchAuction = isDutchAuction;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
        mp.merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function editMintPassWhiteListMerkleRoot(bytes32 merkleRoot, uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].merkleRoot = merkleRoot;
    }

    function mintPasses(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, address, bool, string memory) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return (mp.totalSupply, mp.maxSupply, mp.startTime, mp.endTime, mp.startPrice, mp.endPrice, mp.priceDropInterval, mp.maxPerTx, mp.claimed[msg.sender], mp.redeemer, mp.isDutchAuction, mp.uri);
    }

    function setDutchAuctionSettings(uint256 id, bool isDutchAuction, uint256 startPrice, uint256 endPrice, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 priceDropInterval, uint256 maxPerTx) public onlyOwner {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        mp.isDutchAuction = isDutchAuction;
        mp.startPrice = startPrice;
        mp.endPrice = endPrice;
        mp.startTime = startTime;
        mp.endTime = endTime;
        mp.priceDropInterval = priceDropInterval;
        mp.maxPerTx = maxPerTx;
    }

    function getDutchTiers(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return (mp.startPrice, mp.endPrice, mp.startTime, mp.endTime, mp.priceDropInterval, mp.maxPerTx, mp.totalSupply);
    }

    function isSaleOpen(uint256 id) public view returns (bool) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        return mp.exists && block.timestamp >= mp.startTime && block.timestamp <= mp.endTime;
    }

    function turnSaleOn(uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].exists = true;
    }

    function turnSaleOff(uint256 id) public onlyOwner {
        _mintPasses[id].exists = false;
    }

    function getRemainingPassSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _mintPasses[id].maxSupply - _mintPasses[id].totalSupply;
    }

    function getClaimedMps(uint256 id, address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _mintPasses[id].claimed[account];
    }

    function getTokenSupply(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply[id];
    }

    function getPrice(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        if (!mp.isDutchAuction) {
            return mp.startPrice;
        }
        if (block.timestamp < mp.startTime) {
            return mp.startPrice;
        }
        if (block.timestamp >= mp.endTime) {
            return mp.endPrice;
        }
        uint256 timeElapsed = block.timestamp - mp.startTime;
        uint256 totalPriceDrops = (mp.endTime - mp.startTime) / mp.priceDropInterval;
        uint256 priceDropAmount = (mp.startPrice - mp.endPrice) / totalPriceDrops;
        return mp.startPrice - (timeElapsed / mp.priceDropInterval * priceDropAmount);
    }

    function getRemainingTimeBeforeNextPricingChange(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        MintPass storage mp = _mintPasses[id];
        if (!mp.isDutchAuction) return 0;
        uint256 timeSinceStart = block.timestamp - mp.startTime;
        uint256 intervals = timeSinceStart / mp.priceDropInterval;
        uint256 nextChangeTime = mp.startTime + ((intervals + 1) * mp.priceDropInterval);
        if (nextChangeTime > mp.endTime) return 0;
        return nextChangeTime - block.timestamp;
    }

    // Minting functions
    function mint(address to, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public onlyRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        _mint(to, id, amount, "");
    }

    function mintBatch(address to, uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts) public onlyRole(HABIBI_OPERATOR_ROLE) {
        _mintBatch(to, ids, amounts, "");
    }

    function burnFromRedeem(address from, uint256 id, uint256 amount) public {
        require(_mintPasses[id].redeemer == msg.sender, "Burnable: Only allowed from redeemer");
        _burn(from, id, amount);
    }

    // Claim functions
    function claim(uint256 id, uint256 amount, uint256 maxAmount, bytes32[] memory merkleProof) public payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_mintPasses[id].exists, "Sale is not a dutch auction");
        require(!_paused, "Sale is paused");
        require(_mintPasses[id].totalSupply + amount <= _mintPasses[id].maxSupply, "No supply remaining");
        require(block.timestamp >= _mintPasses[id].startTime && block.timestamp <= _mintPasses[id].endTime, "Claim: time window closed");
        require(msg.value >= getPrice(id) * amount, "Payment amount is incorrect");
        require(_mintPasses[id].claimed[msg.sender] + amount <= maxAmount, "Claim: Not allowed to claim given amount");
        require(amount <= _mintPasses[id].maxPerTx, "Max quantity per transaction exceeded");
        require(verifyMerkleProof(merkleProof, id, maxAmount), "MerkleDistributor: Invalid proof");

        _mintPasses[id].claimed[msg.sender] += amount;
        _mintPasses[id].totalSupply += amount;
        _mint(msg.sender, id, amount, "");
        emit Claimed(id, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function claimMultiple(uint256[] memory ids, uint256[] memory amounts, uint256[] memory maxAmounts, bytes32[][] memory merkleProofs) public payable whenNotPaused {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
            claim(ids[i], amounts[i], maxAmounts[i], merkleProofs[i]);
        }
        emit ClaimedMultiple(ids, msg.sender, amounts);
    }

    function verifyMerkleProof(bytes32[] memory proof, uint256 id, uint256 maxAmount) public view returns (bool) {
        bytes32 leaf = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, maxAmount));
        bytes32 root = _mintPasses[id].merkleRoot;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < proof.length; i++) {
            leaf = leaf < proof[i] ? keccak256(abi.encodePacked(leaf, proof[i])) : keccak256(abi.encodePacked(proof[i], leaf));
        }
        return leaf == root;
    }

    function makeLeaf(address account, uint256 maxAmount) public pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(account, maxAmount));
    }

    // Withdraw
    function withdrawEther(address payable to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }
}

interface IERC1155Receiver {
    function onERC1155Received(address operator, address from, uint256 id, uint256 value, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
    function onERC1155BatchReceived(address operator, address from, uint256[] calldata ids, uint256[] calldata values, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes4);
}
