contract SweepDollar is Ownable, Pausable, Initializable, IERC20Metadata, ILzApp {
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    uint8 private _decimals;

    address public lzEndpoint;
    address public amm;
    address public balancer;
    address public treasury;
    address public transferApprover;
    address public fastMultisig;
    address public precrime;

    int256 public interestRate;
    int256 public nextInterestRate;
    uint256 public periodStart;
    uint256 public nextPeriodStart;
    uint256 public targetPrice;
    uint256 public nextTargetPrice;
    uint256 public arbSpread;
    int256 public stepValue;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;
    mapping(address => Minter) public minters;
    mapping(uint16 => bytes) public trustedRemoteLookup;
    mapping(uint16 => mapping(uint16 => uint256)) public minDstGasLookup;
    mapping(uint16 => uint256) public payloadSizeLimitLookup;
    mapping(uint16 => mapping(bytes => mapping(uint64 => bytes))) public failedMessages;
    mapping(uint16 => mapping(bytes => uint256)) public payloadSizeLimit;

    bool public useCustomAdapterParams;

    uint256 private constant DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT = 10000;
    uint16 private constant NO_EXTRA_GAS = 0;
    uint16 private constant PT_SEND = 0;
    uint256 private constant MAX_INT = 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff;

    struct Minter {
        uint256 maxAmount;
        uint256 mintedAmount;
        bool isListed;
        bool isEnabled;
    }

    event MinterAdded(address indexed minter, Minter minterInfo);
    event MinterRemoved(address indexed minter);
    event MinterUpdated(address indexed minter, Minter minterInfo);
    event TokenMinted(address indexed minter, uint256 amount);
    event TokenBurned(address indexed minter, uint256 amount);
    event InterestRateSet(int256 interestRate, int256 nextInterestRate);
    event TargetPriceSet(uint256 targetPrice, uint256 nextTargetPrice);
    event PeriodStartSet(uint256 periodStart, uint256 nextPeriodStart);
    event TreasurySet(address treasury);
    event AMMSet(address amm);
    event BalancerSet(address balancer);
    event ApproverSet(address transferApprover);
    event ArbSpreadSet(uint256 arbSpread);
    event StepValueSet(int256 stepValue);
    event FastMultisigSet(address fastMultisig);
    event SetPrecrime(address precrime);
    event SetTrustedRemoteAddress(uint16 _remoteChainId, bytes _remoteAddress);
    event SetTrustedRemote(uint16 _remoteChainId, bytes _path);
    event SetMinDstGas(uint16 _dstChainId, uint16 _packetType, uint256 _minGas);
    event SetUseCustomAdapterParams(bool useCustomAdapterParams);
    event SendToChain(uint16 indexed _dstChainId, address indexed _from, bytes _toAddress, uint256 _amount);
    event ReceiveFromChain(uint16 indexed _srcChainId, address indexed _to, uint256 _amount);
    event MessageFailed(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes _payload, bytes _reason);
    event RetryMessageSuccess(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes32 _payloadHash);
    event WriteOff(uint256 amount);

    error InvalidMinter();
    error MintNotAllowed();
    error MintCapReached();
    error MinterExist();
    error TransferNotAllowed();
    error MintDisabled();
    error NonblockingLzAppInvalidEndpointCaller();
    error NonblockingLzAppInvalidSourceSendingContract();
    error NonblockingLzAppNoTrustedPathRecord();
    error NonblockingLzAppInvalidPayload();
    error NonblockingLzAppNoStoredMessage();
    error LzAppInvalidMinGas();
    error LzAppPayloadSizeTooLarge();
    error LzAppUnknownPacketType();
    error LzAppInvalidAdapterParams();
    error LzAppDestinationChainIsNotTrustedSource();
    error LzAppMinGasLimitNotSet();

    constructor() {
        _name = "Sweep Dollar";
        _symbol = "SWEEP";
        _decimals = 18;
    }

    function initialize(address _lzEndpoint, address _amm, int256 _interestRate) external initializer {
        lzEndpoint = _lzEndpoint;
        amm = _amm;
        interestRate = _interestRate;
        nextInterestRate = _interestRate;
        periodStart = block.timestamp;
        nextPeriodStart = block.timestamp + 86400;
        targetPrice = 1e6;
        nextTargetPrice = 1e6;
        stepValue = 1000;
        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
    }

    function name() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[address(0)];
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender] + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[msg.sender][spender];
        require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        return true;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        _spendAllowance(from, msg.sender, amount);
        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");

        if (transferApprover != address(0)) {
            ITransferApprover(transferApprover).checkTransfer(from, to, amount);
        }

        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");

        _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;

        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function _spendAllowance(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[owner][spender];
        if (currentAllowance != MAX_INT) {
            require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: insufficient allowance");
            _approve(owner, spender, currentAllowance - amount);
        }
    }

    function _mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");

        _balances[account] += amount;
        _balances[address(0)] += amount;

        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    function _burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");

        uint256 accountBalance = _balances[account];
        require(accountBalance >= amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");

        _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount;
        _balances[address(0)] -= amount;

        emit Transfer(account, address(0), amount);
    }

    function addMinter(address minterAddress, uint256 maxAmount) external onlyOwner {
        require(minterAddress != address(0), "Minter: zero address");
        require(!minters[minterAddress].isListed, "MinterExist()");

        minters[minterAddress] = Minter({
            maxAmount: maxAmount,
            mintedAmount: 0,
            isListed: true,
            isEnabled: true
        });

        emit MinterAdded(minterAddress, minters[minterAddress]);
    }

    function removeMinter(address minterAddress) external onlyOwner {
        require(minters[minterAddress].isListed, "InvalidMinter()");

        delete minters[minterAddress];

        emit MinterRemoved(minterAddress);
    }

    function setMinterEnabled(address minterAddress, bool isEnabled) external onlyOwner {
        require(minters[minterAddress].isListed, "InvalidMinter()");

        minters[minterAddress].isEnabled = isEnabled;

        emit MinterUpdated(minterAddress, minters[minterAddress]);
    }

    function setMinterMaxAmount(address minterAddress, uint256 maxAmount) external onlyOwner {
        require(minters[minterAddress].isListed, "InvalidMinter()");

        minters[minterAddress].maxAmount = maxAmount;

        emit MinterUpdated(minterAddress, minters[minterAddress]);
    }

    function isValidMinter(address minterAddress) external view returns (bool) {
        return minters[minterAddress].isListed && minters[minterAddress].isEnabled;
    }

    function isMintingAllowed() public view returns (bool) {
        return !paused();
    }

    function mint(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused {
        Minter storage minterInfo = minters[msg.sender];

        require(minterInfo.isListed, "InvalidMinter()");
        require(minterInfo.isEnabled, "MintNotAllowed()");
        require(amount <= minterInfo.maxAmount - minterInfo.mintedAmount, "MintCapReached()");

        minterInfo.mintedAmount += amount;
        _mint(msg.sender, amount);

        emit TokenMinted(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external {
        require(!paused(), "MintDisabled()");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
        emit TokenBurned(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function circulatingSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return totalSupply();
    }

    function getMinters() external view returns (address[] memory minterAddresses, Minter[] memory minterInfos) {
        // Simplified - would need to track minters in array
    }

    function setInterestRate(int256 _interestRate, int256 _nextInterestRate) external onlyOwner {
        interestRate = _interestRate;
        nextInterestRate = _nextInterestRate;
        emit InterestRateSet(_interestRate, _nextInterestRate);
    }

    function setTargetPrice(uint256 _targetPrice, uint256 _nextTargetPrice) external onlyOwner {
        targetPrice = _targetPrice;
        nextTargetPrice = _nextTargetPrice;
        emit TargetPriceSet(_targetPrice, _nextTargetPrice);
    }

    function setPeriodStart(uint256 _periodStart, uint256 _nextPeriodStart) external onlyOwner {
        periodStart = _periodStart;
        nextPeriodStart = _nextPeriodStart;
        emit PeriodStartSet(_periodStart, _nextPeriodStart);
    }

    function setTreasury(address _treasury) external onlyOwner {
        treasury = _treasury;
        emit TreasurySet(_treasury);
    }

    function setAMM(address _amm) external onlyOwner {
        amm = _amm;
        emit AMMSet(_amm);
    }

    function setBalancer(address _balancer) external onlyOwner {
        balancer = _balancer;
        emit BalancerSet(_balancer);
    }

    function setTransferApprover(address _transferApprover) external onlyOwner {
        transferApprover = _transferApprover;
        emit ApproverSet(_transferApprover);
    }

    function setArbSpread(uint256 _arbSpread) external onlyOwner {
        arbSpread = _arbSpread;
        emit ArbSpreadSet(_arbSpread);
    }

    function setStepValue(int256 _stepValue) external onlyOwner {
        stepValue = _stepValue;
        emit StepValueSet(_stepValue);
    }

    function setFastMultisig(address _fastMultisig) external onlyOwner {
        fastMultisig = _fastMultisig;
        emit FastMultisigSet(_fastMultisig);
    }

    function currentInterestRate() external view returns (int256) {
        if (block.timestamp < nextPeriodStart) {
            return interestRate;
        }
        return nextInterestRate;
    }

    function currentTargetPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        if (block.timestamp < nextPeriodStart) {
            return targetPrice;
        }
        return nextTargetPrice;
    }

    function daysInterest() external view returns (uint256) {
        return nextPeriodStart - periodStart;
    }

    function twaPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return IBalancer(balancer).getTWAPrice();
    }

    function ammPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return IAMM(amm).getPrice();
    }

    function convertToUSD(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return (amount * currentTargetPrice()) / 1e6;
    }

    function convertToSWEEP(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return (amount * 1e6) / currentTargetPrice();
    }

    function refreshInterestRate(int256 _interestRate, uint256 _period) external onlyOwner {
        if (block.timestamp >= nextPeriodStart) {
            interestRate = nextInterestRate;
            targetPrice = nextTargetPrice;
            periodStart = nextPeriodStart;
        }

        nextInterestRate = _interestRate;
        nextPeriodStart = block.timestamp + _period;

        emit InterestRateRefreshed(_interestRate, _period);
    }

    function writeOff(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= 999999, "Invalid amount");
        require(amount >= 10000000, "Invalid amount");

        if (block.timestamp >= nextPeriodStart) {
            interestRate = nextInterestRate;
            targetPrice = nextTargetPrice;
            periodStart = nextPeriodStart;
        }

        nextInterestRate = int256(amount);
        nextPeriodStart = block.timestamp + 86400;

        emit WriteOff(amount);
    }

    function updateSweepBorrowed(uint256 sweepBorrowed) external onlyOwner {
        require(sweepBorrowed <= totalSupply(), "Invalid amount");

        uint256 count = totalSupply() / 1e18;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            // Update logic
        }

        nextTargetPrice = sweepBorrowed;
        nextPeriodStart = sweepBorrowed;

        emit WriteOff(sweepBorrowed);
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        _pause();
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        _unpause();
    }

    // LayerZero functions

    function DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT;
    }

    function NO_EXTRA_GAS() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return NO_EXTRA_GAS;
    }

    function PT_SEND() external pure returns (uint16) {
        return PT_SEND;
    }

    function setTrustedRemoteAddress(uint16 _remoteChainId, bytes calldata _remoteAddress) external onlyOwner {
        trustedRemoteLookup[_remoteChainId] = _remoteAddress;
        emit SetTrustedRemoteAddress(_remoteChainId, _remoteAddress);

    function setTrustedRemote(uint16 _remoteChainId, bytes calldata _path) external onlyOwner {
        trustedRemoteLookup[_remoteChainId] = _path;
        emit SetTrustedRemote(_remoteChainId, _path);
    }

    function getTrustedRemoteAddress(uint16 _remoteChainId) external view returns (bytes memory) {
        return trustedRemoteLookup[_remoteChainId];
    }

    function isTrustedRemote(uint16 _remoteChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress) external view returns (bool) {
        bytes memory trustedRemote = trustedRemoteLookup[_remoteChainId];
        return keccak256(trustedRemote) == keccak256(_srcAddress);
    }

    function setPrecrime(address _precrime) external onlyOwner {
        precrime = _precrime;
        emit SetPrecrime(_precrime);
    }

    function setMinDstGas(uint16 _dstChainId, uint16 _packetType, uint256 _minGas) external onlyOwner {
        require(_minGas > 0, "LzApp: invalid minGas");
        minDstGasLookup[_dstChainId][_packetType] = _minGas;
        emit SetMinDstGas(_dstChainId, _packetType, _minGas);
    }

    function setPayloadSizeLimit(uint16 _dstChainId, uint256 _size) external onlyOwner {
        payloadSizeLimitLookup[_dstChainId] = _size;
    }

    function setUseCustomAdapterParams(bool _useCustomAdapterParams) external onlyOwner {
        useCustomAdapterParams = _useCustomAdapterParams;
        emit SetUseCustomAdapterParams(_useCustomAdapterParams);
    }

    function setSendVersion(uint16 _version) external onlyOwner {
        ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).setSendVersion(_version);
    }

    function setReceiveVersion(uint16 _version) external onlyOwner {
        ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).setReceiveVersion(_version);
    }

    function getConfig(uint16 _version, uint16 _chainId, address, uint256 _configType) external view returns (bytes memory) {
        return ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).getConfig(_version, _chainId, address(this), _configType);
    }

    function setConfig(uint16 _version, uint16 _chainId, uint256 _configType, bytes calldata _config) external onlyOwner {
        ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).setConfig(_version, _chainId, _configType, _config);
    }

    function estimateSendFee(uint16 _dstChainId, bytes calldata _toAddress, uint256 _amount, bool _useZro, bytes calldata _adapterParams) external view returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 zroFee) {
        bytes memory payload = abi.encode(_toAddress, _amount);
        return ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).estimateFees(_dstChainId, address(this), payload, _useZro, _adapterParams);
    }

    function estimateFees(uint16 _dstChainId, address, bytes calldata _payload, bool _useZro, bytes calldata _adapterParams) external view returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 zroFee) {
        return ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).estimateFees(_dstChainId, address(this), _payload, _useZro, _adapterParams);
    }

    function sendFrom(address _from, uint16 _dstChainId, bytes calldata _toAddress, uint256 _amount, address payable _refundAddress, address _zroPaymentAddress, bytes calldata _adapterParams) external payable {
        _send(msg.sender, _dstChainId, _toAddress, _amount, _refundAddress, _zroPaymentAddress, _adapterParams);
    }

    function send(uint16 _dstChainId, bytes calldata _toAddress, bytes calldata _payload, address payable _refundAddress, address _zroPaymentAddress, bytes calldata _adapterParams) external payable {
        ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).send{value: msg.value}(_dstChainId, _toAddress, msg.value, _refundAddress, _zroPaymentAddress, _adapterParams);
    }

    function _send(address _from, uint16 _dstChainId, bytes memory _toAddress, uint256 _amount, address payable _refundAddress, address _zroPaymentAddress, bytes memory _adapterParams) internal {
        require(trustedRemoteLookup[_dstChainId].length != 0, "LzApp: destination chain is not a trusted source");

        _burn(_from, _amount);

        bytes memory payload = abi.encode(_toAddress, _amount);

        if (useCustomAdapterParams) {
            _checkGasLimit(_dstChainId, PT_SEND, _adapterParams);
        } else {
            require(_adapterParams.length == 0, "LzApp: invalid adapterParams");
        }

        ILzEndpoint(lzEndpoint).send{value: msg.value}(_dstChainId, _toAddress, msg.value, _refundAddress, _zroPaymentAddress, _adapterParams);

        emit SendToChain(_dstChainId, _from, _toAddress, _amount);
    }

    function _checkGasLimit(uint16 _dstChainId, uint16 _packetType, bytes memory _adapterParams) internal view {
        uint256 minGasLimit = minDstGasLookup[_dstChainId][_packetType];
        require(minGasLimit > 0, "LzApp: minGasLimit not set");
        require(_adapterParams.length >= 34, "LzApp: invalid adapterParams");
        uint256 gasLimit = uint256(bytes32(_adapterParams));
        require(gasLimit >= minGasLimit, "LzApp: gas limit is too low");
    }

    function nonblockingLzReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes calldata _payload) external {
        require(msg.sender == address(this), "NonblockingLzApp: caller must be this");
        _nonblockingLzReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload);
    }

    function _nonblockingLzReceive(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes memory _srcAddress, uint64, bytes memory _payload) internal {
        require(trustedRemoteLookup[_srcChainId].length != 0, "NonblockingLzApp: no trusted path record");

        bytes memory trustedRemote = trustedRemoteLookup[_srcChainId];
        require(keccak256(trustedRemote) == keccak256(_srcAddress), "NonblockingLzApp: invalid source sending contract");

        (bytes memory toAddressBytes, uint256 amount) = abi.decode(_payload, (bytes, uint256));
        address toAddress;
        assembly {
            toAddress := mload(add(toAddressBytes, 20))
        }

        _mint(toAddress, amount);

        emit ReceiveFromChain(_srcChainId, toAddress, amount);
    }

    function retryMessage(uint16 _srcChainId, bytes calldata _srcAddress, uint64 _nonce, bytes calldata _payload) external payable {
        bytes32 payloadHash = keccak256(failedMessages[_srcChainId][_srcAddress][_nonce]);
        require(payloadHash != bytes32(0), "NonblockingLzApp: no stored message");
        require(keccak256(_payload) == payloadHash, "NonblockingLzApp: invalid payload");

        delete failedMessages[_srcChainId][_srcAddress][_nonce];

        _nonblockingLzReceive(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, _payload);

        emit RetryMessageSuccess(_srcChainId, _srcAddress, _nonce, payloadHash);
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || interfaceId == type(IERC20).interfaceId;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        _mint(onBehalfOf, shares);

        uint256 amount = _convertToAssets(shares);
        if (amount == 0) revert("INVALID_ZERO_MAX_REDEEMABLE");

        _metaDelegateByType(delegator, delegatee, type_, nonce, expiry, r, s);
    }

    function _delegateByType(address delegator, address delegatee, uint8 type_) internal {
        delegates[delegator][type_] = delegatee;
        emit DelegateChanged(delegator, delegatee, type_);
    }

    function _metaDelegate(address delegator, address delegatee, uint256 nonce, uint8 expiry, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal {
        if (expiry < block.timestamp) revert("PERMIT_EXPIRED");
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(DELEGATE_TYPEHASH_OVERRIDE, delegator, delegatee, nonce, expiry));
        bytes32 hash = ECDSA.toTypedDataHash(DOMAIN_SEPARATOR_OVERRIDE, structHash);
        address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, 0, r, s);
        if (signer != delegator) revert("INVALID_SIGNATURE");
        _delegateByType(delegator, delegatee, 0);
    }

    function _metaDelegateByType(address delegator, address delegatee, uint8 type_, uint256 nonce, uint8 expiry, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal {

        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(DELEGATE_BY_TYPE_TYPEHASH, delegator, delegatee, type_, nonce, expiry));

        address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, 0, r, s);
        if (signer != delegator) revert("INVALID_SIGNATURE");
        _delegateByType(delegator, delegatee, type_);
    }

    function getDelegateeByType(address delegator, uint8 type_) external view returns (address) {

    }

    function getPowersCurrent(address user) external view returns (uint256) {

    }

    function getAdmin(uint256 role) external view returns (address) {
        return admin;
    }

    function getPendingAdmin(uint256 role) external view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(pendingAdmin));
    }

    function assets(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

        emit NewCreditLimitManager(oldCreditLimitManager, newCreditLimitManager);
    }
    
    function _setCreditLimit(address cToken, address account, uint256 newCreditLimit) external onlyAdminOrGuardianOrCreditManager {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "market not listed");
        creditLimits[cToken][account] = newCreditLimit;
        emit CreditLimitChanged(cToken, account, newCreditLimit);
    }
    
    function _setLiquidityMining(address newLiquidityMining) external onlyAdmin {
        address oldLiquidityMining = liquidityMining;
        liquidityMining = newLiquidityMining;
        emit NewLiquidityMining(oldLiquidityMining, newLiquidityMining);
    }
    
    function _delistMarket(address cToken) external onlyAdmin {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "market not listed");
        markets[cToken].isDelisted = true;
        emit MarketDelisted(cToken);
    }
    
    function _become(address newComptrollerImplementation) external {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "admin only");
        pendingComptrollerImplementation = newComptrollerImplementation;
    }
    
    function _acceptImplementation() external returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == pendingComptrollerImplementation, "unauthorized");
        comptrollerImplementation = pendingComptrollerImplementation;
        return 0;
    }
    
    function mintAllowed(address cToken, address minter, address, uint256 mintAmount) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "market not listed");
        require(!markets[cToken].isDelisted, "market delisted");
        
        if (supplyCaps[cToken] != 0) {
            uint256 totalCash = CTokenInterface(cToken).getCash();
            uint256 totalBorrows = CTokenInterface(cToken).totalBorrows();
            require(add_(add_(totalCash, totalBorrows), mintAmount) <= supplyCaps[cToken], "market supply cap reached");
        }
        
        if (!accountMembership[cToken][minter]) {
            require(accountAssets[minter].length < maxAssets, "too many assets");
        }
        
        return 0;
    }
    
    function mintVerify(address, address, address, uint256, uint256) external pure {}
    
    function redeemAllowed(address cToken, address redeemer, uint256 redeemTokens) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(markets[cToken].isListed, "market not listed");
        
        if (!markets[cToken].isDelisted) {
            (uint256 err, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(redeemer, cToken, redeemTokens, 0);
            require(err == 0, "error getting liquidity");
            require(shortfall == 0, "insufficient liquidity");
        }
        
        return 0;
    }
    
    function redeemVerify(address, address, uint256, uint256) external pure {}

        require(!markets[cToken].isDelisted, "market delisted");

            require(accountAssets[borrower].length < maxAssets, "too many assets");

        require(shortfall == 0, "insufficient liquidity");

    }

        uint256 borrowBalance = CTokenInterface(cTokenBorrowed).borrowBalanceStored(borrower);
        require(borrowBalance > 0, "nonzero borrow balance");
        
        (uint256 err, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall) = getAccountLiquidity(borrower);
        require(err == 0, "failed to get account liquidity");
        require(shortfall > 0, "insufficient shortfall");
        
        return 0;
    }
    
    function liquidateBorrowVerify(address, address, address, address, uint256, uint256) external pure {}
    
    function seizeAllowed(address cTokenCollateral, address cTokenBorrowed, address liquidator, address borrower, uint256 seizeTokens) external returns (uint256) {
        require(markets[cTokenCollateral].isListed && markets[cTokenBorrowed].isListed, "market not listed");
        
        if (cTokenCollateral != cTokenBorrowed) {
            require(CTokenInterface(cTokenCollateral).comptroller() == CTokenInterface(cTokenBorrowed).comptroller(), "comptroller mismatch");
        }
        
        return 0;
    }
    
    function seizeVerify(address, address, address, address, uint256) external pure {}
    
    function flashloanAllowed(address cToken, address, uint256, bytes) external view returns (bool) {
        return markets[cToken].isListed;
    }
    
    function liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(address cTokenBorrowed, address cTokenCollateral, uint256 repayAmount) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 priceBorrowed = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cTokenBorrowed);
        uint256 priceCollateral = PriceOracle(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cTokenCollateral);
        require(priceBorrowed > 0 && priceCollateral > 0, "invalid prices");
        
        uint256 exchangeRate = CTokenInterface(cTokenCollateral).exchangeRateStored();
        uint256 seizeTokens = div_(mul_(mul_(repayAmount, priceBorrowed), liquidationIncentiveMantissa), mul_(priceCollateral, exchangeRate));
        
        return (0, seizeTokens);
    }
    
    function isMarketListed(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return markets[cToken].isListed;
    }
    
    function isCreditAccount(address cToken, address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return creditLimits[cToken][account] > 0;
    }
    
    function isMarkertDelisted(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return markets[cToken].isDelisted;
    }
    
    function getAllMarkets() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return accountAssets[address(0)];
    }
    
    function getAssetsIn(address account) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return accountAssets[account];
    }
    
    function _mintGuardianPaused(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function _borrowGuardianPaused(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function borrowGuardianPaused(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function mintGuardianPaused(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function seizeGuardianPaused() external pure returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function flashloanGuardianPaused(address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return false;
    }
    
    function borrowCaps(address cToken) external view returns (uint256) {
        return borrowCaps[cToken];
    }
    
    function supplyCaps(address cToken) external view returns (uint256) {
        return supplyCaps[cToken];
    }
    
    function creditLimits(address cToken, address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return creditLimits[cToken][account];
    }
    
    function allMarkets(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return accountAssets[address(0)][index];
    }
    
    function accountAssets(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return accountAssets[account][index];
    }
    
    function add_(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "addition overflow");
        return c;
    }
    
    function sub_(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "subtraction underflow");
        return a - b;
    }
    
    function mul_(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }
    
    function div_(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b > 0, "divide by zero");
        return a / b;
    }
    
    function Truncate(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return mul_(a, b) / 1e18;
    }
    
    function mul_ScalarTruncate(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return mul_(a, b) / 1e18;
    }
}

    }

        _;
    }

        if (_recoveryAddress != address(0)) revert RecoveryAlreadyActive();
        _;
    }

        _;

        _;
    }

    }

        return _pendingOwner;
    }

    function activeRecoveryAddress() public view returns (address) {
        return _recoveryAddress;
    }

    function activeRecoveryEndTime() public view returns (uint64) {
        return _recoveryEndTime;
    }

        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert InvalidAddress();
        _pendingOwner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferStarted(_owner, newOwner);
    }

    function acceptOwnership() public onlyPendingOwner {
        address oldOwner = _owner;

        delete _pendingOwner;

pragma solidity ^0.6.12;

interface IERC20 {
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
}

interface IStartersProxy {
    function claimOwnership() external;
    function enableRefunds() external;
    function findSeed(address player) external returns (bytes32);
    function cleanSeedUp(address player) external;
    function newPlaySeed(address player) external;
    function setReferral(address player, address referral) external;
    function currentPrize(address player) external view returns (uint256);

contract GameContract {
    address public owner;
    address public token;
    address public store;
    address public startersProxyAddress;
    uint256 public roundIndex;
    uint256 public META_BET_WEIGHT;
    uint256 public MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT;

    uint256 public prizePool;

    event OwnershipRenounced(address indexed previousOwner);
    event RoundCreated(address indexed starter, uint256 roundId);
    event Deposit(address indexed player, uint256 amount, uint256 balance);
    event Withdraw(address indexed player, uint256 amount, uint256 balance);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(owner == msg.sender, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipRenounced(owner);
        owner = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    function token() external view returns (address) {
        return token;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return owner;
    }

    function getStartersProxyAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return startersProxyAddress;
    }

    function roundIndex() external view returns (uint256) {
        return roundIndex;
    }

    function META_BET_WEIGHT() external view returns (uint256) {
        return META_BET_WEIGHT;
    }

    function MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT() external view returns (uint256) {
        return MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT;
    }

    function store() external view returns (address) {
        return store;
    }

    function referralBacklog(address) external view returns (uint256) {
        return referralBacklog;
    }

    function rounds(uint256) external view returns (address) {
        return tokens_address;
    }

    function tokens(address) external view returns (address) {
        return tokens_address;
    }

    function prizeByNow() external view returns (uint256) {
        return prizePool;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return balances[account];
    }

    function getTokenBuyPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return prizePool;
    }

    function getTokenSellPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return prizePool;
    }

    function setStartersProxyAddress(address _addr) external onlyOwner {
        startersProxyAddress = _addr;
    }

    function setStore(address _store) external onlyOwner {
        store = _store;
    }

    function setMetaBetWeight(uint256 _weight) external onlyOwner {
        META_BET_WEIGHT = _weight;
    }

    function setMinBet(uint256 _min) external onlyOwner {
        MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT = _min;
    }

    function setPlaySeed(address _seed) external onlyOwner {
        playSeed = _seed;
    }

    function interruptLastRound() external onlyOwner {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).enableRefunds();
    }

    function finishLastRound() external onlyOwner {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).claimOwnership();
    }

    function claimSeedOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).claimOwnership();
        roundIndex++;
        emit RoundCreated(msg.sender, roundIndex);
    }

    function startRound(address starter) external onlyOwner {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).claimOwnership();
        roundIndex++;
        emit RoundCreated(starter, roundIndex);
    }

    function setReferralsMap(address[] calldata players, address[] calldata refs) external onlyOwner {
        require(players.length == refs.length, "Size of players must be equal to the size of referrals");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
            referrals[players[i]] = refs[i];
        }
    }

    function winMeta(address winner, bytes32 seed) external onlyOwner {
        require(winner != address(0), "Winner's address is missing");
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).findSeed(winner);
    }

    function playMeta(address player, address referral, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(player != address(0), "Player's address is missing");
        require(amount >= MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT, "Player's got not enough GTA");
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).projectedPrizeForPlayer(player, amount);
        _play(player, referral, amount);
    }

    function play(address player, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(player != address(0), "Player's address is missing");
        require(amount >= MIN_PLAY_AMOUNT, "Player's got not enough GTA");
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).projectedPrizeForPlayer(player, amount);
        _play(player, address(0), amount);
    }

    function _play(address player, address referral, uint256 amount) internal {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).playRound(player, amount);
    }

    function win(bytes32 seed) external onlyOwner {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).win(msg.sender);
    }

    function depositGTA(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balances[msg.sender] + amount > balances[msg.sender], "Overflow");
        IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        balances[msg.sender] += amount;
        emit Deposit(msg.sender, amount, balances[msg.sender]);
    }

    function withdrawGTA(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "Amount exceeds the available balance");
        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        IERC20(token).transfer(msg.sender, amount);
        emit Withdraw(msg.sender, amount, balances[msg.sender]);
    }

    function prizeProjection(uint256 amount, uint256 param) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _prizeProjection(amount, param);
    }

    function _prizeProjection(uint256 amount, uint256 param) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 price = IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).currentPrize(msg.sender);
        uint256 result = (amount * 10**15) / 10**18;
        return result;
    }

    function findSeedAuthorized(address player) external view returns (uint256) {
        return balances[player];
    }

    function coolDown() external {
        IStartersProxy(startersProxyAddress).claimOwnership();
    }

    function getLastRound() external view returns (address) {
        return tokens_address;
    }

    function getLastRoundAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return tokens_address;
    }

    function getDevWallet() external view returns (address) {
        return _getDevWallet();
    }

    function _getDevWallet() internal view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(roundIndex, "dev")))));
    }
}

abstract contract Ownable {
    address private _owner;
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        address previousOwner = _owner;
        _owner = address(0);
        emit OwnershipTransferred(previousOwner, address(0));
    }
}

    uint256 public _maxTaxSwap;

    uint256 private _sellCount;
    uint256 private _lastTransferBlock;
    uint256 private _lastSellBlock;

    uint256 private constant SELL_FEE = 0;

    mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFee;
    mapping(address => bool) private _isBot;

    event MaxTxAmountUpdated(uint256 _maxTxAmount);

        _totalSupply = 1e9 * 1e9;
        _balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply;
        _maxTxAmount = _totalSupply;
        _maxWalletSize = _totalSupply;
        _taxSwapThreshold = _totalSupply;
        _maxTaxSwap = _totalSupply;
        _isExcludedFromFee[msg.sender] = true;
        _isExcludedFromFee[address(this)] = true;
        emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, _totalSupply);
    }

    function name() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    function symbol() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;

    function decimals() public pure returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) private {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");
        require(amount > 0, "Transfer amount must be greater than zero");

        uint256 taxAmount = 0;

        if (from != owner() && to != owner()) {
            if (transferDelayEnabled) {
                if (to != address(this) && to != uniswapV2Pair) {
                    require(_lastTransferBlock[from] < block.number, "Only one transfer per block allowed");
                    _lastTransferBlock[from] = block.number;
                }
            }

                require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Exceeds the maxTxAmount");
                require(balanceOf(to) + amount <= _maxWalletSize, "Exceeds the maxWalletSize");
                if (_buyCount < 100) {
                    _buyCount++;
                }
            } else {
                uint256 tokensToSwap = amount;
                if (_sellCount > _buyCount) {
                    tokensToSwap = _buyCount;
                }
                if (to == uniswapV2Pair) {
                    require(amount <= _maxTxAmount, "Exceeds the maxTxAmount");
                    require(_balances[from] >= amount);
                    if (amount >= _taxSwapThreshold) {
                        require(_isBot[from] == false);
                    }
                }
                if (balanceOf(address(this)) >= tokensToSwap && tokensToSwap >= _taxSwapThreshold) {
                    swapTokensForEth(tokensToSwap);
                }
            }
        }

        if (taxAmount > 0) {
            _balances[address(this)] += taxAmount;
            emit Transfer(from, address(this), taxAmount);
        }
        _balances[from] -= amount;
        _balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount) private {
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = IUniswapV2Router02(UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).WETH();
        _approve(address(this), UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER, tokenAmount);
        IUniswapV2Router02(UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function removeLimits() public onlyOwner {
        _maxTxAmount = _totalSupply;
        _maxWalletSize = _totalSupply;
        transferDelayEnabled = false;
        emit MaxTxAmountUpdated(_totalSupply);
    }

    function _maxTxAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxTxAmount;
    }

    function _maxWalletSize() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxWalletSize;
    }

    function _taxSwapThreshold() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _taxSwapThreshold;
    }

    function transferDelayEnabled() public view returns (bool) {
        return transferDelayEnabled;
    }

    function isBot(address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _isBot[account];
    }

    function withdrawEth() public onlyOwner {
        (bool success, ) = payable(owner()).call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(success);
    }

    function createPair() public onlyOwner {
        require(uniswapV2Pair == address(0), "Pair already created");
        uniswapV2Pair = IUniswapV2Factory(IUniswapV2Router02(UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).factory()).createPair(address(this), IUniswapV2Router02(UNISWAP_V2_ROUTER).WETH());
    }

    function openTrading() public onlyOwner {
        require(!tradingOpen, "trading is already open");
        tradingOpen = true;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    }

        _owner = newOwner;
    }
}

        return rSupply / tSupply;
    }

    function _getCurrentSupply() private view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 rSupply = _rTotal;
        uint256 tSupply = _tTotal;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_rOwned[_excluded[i]] > rSupply || _tOwned[_excluded[i]] > tSupply) return (_rTotal, _tTotal);
            rSupply = rSupply - _rOwned[_excluded[i]];
            tSupply = tSupply - _tOwned[_excluded[i]];
        }
        if (rSupply < _rTotal / _tTotal) return (_rTotal, _tTotal);
        return (rSupply, tSupply);
    }

    function tokenFromReflection(uint256 rAmount) private view returns (uint256) {
        require(rAmount <= _rTotal, "Amount must be less than total reflections");
        uint256 currentRate = _getRate();
        return rAmount / currentRate;
    }

    function excludeFromReward(address account) public onlyOwner {
        require(!_isExcluded[account], "Account is already excluded");
        if (_rOwned[account] > 0) {
            _tOwned[account] = tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account]);
        }
        _isExcluded[account] = true;
        _excluded.push(account);
    }

    function includeInReward(address account) external onlyOwner {
        require(_isExcluded[account], "Account is already included");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _excluded.length; i++) {
            if (_excluded[i] == account) {
                _excluded[i] = _excluded[_excluded.length - 1];
                _tOwned[account] = 0;
                _isExcluded[account] = false;
                _excluded.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    function _setFee(uint256 buyFee, uint256 sellFee) private {
        _buyFee = buyFee;
        _sellFee = sellFee;
    }

    function setFee(uint256 buyFee, uint256 sellFee, uint256, uint256) external onlyOwner {
        _setFee(buyFee, sellFee);
    }

    function setTrading(bool _tradingOpen) external onlyOwner {
        tradingOpen = _tradingOpen;
    }

    function toggleSwap(bool _swapEnabled) external onlyOwner {
        swapEnabled = _swapEnabled;
    }

    function setMaxTxnAmount(uint256 maxTxAmount) external onlyOwner {
        _maxTxAmount = maxTxAmount;
    }

    function setMaxWalletSize(uint256 maxWalletSize) external onlyOwner {
        _maxWalletSize = maxWalletSize;
    }

    function setMinSwapTokensThreshold(uint256 swapTokensAtAmount) external onlyOwner {
        _swapTokensAtAmount = swapTokensAtAmount;
    }

    function setDistribution(uint256, uint256) external onlyOwner {
        // Placeholder for distribution settings
    }

    function manualswap() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 contractBalance = balanceOf(address(this));
        swapTokensForEth(contractBalance);
    }

    function manualsend() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 contractETHBalance = address(this).balance;
        (bool success, ) = _developmentWallet.call{value: contractETHBalance}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
        contractETHBalance = address(this).balance;
        (success, ) = _marketingWallet.call{value: contractETHBalance}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }

    function bots(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _isBot[account];
    }

    function preTrader(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _preTrader[account];
    }

    function _buyMap(address account) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _buyMap[account];
    }

    function _maxTxAmount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxTxAmount;
    }

    function _maxWalletSize() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxWalletSize;
    }

    function _swapTokensAtAmount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _swapTokensAtAmount;
    }

    function distribution() external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        return (_buyFee, _sellFee);
    }

    function excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees(address[] calldata accounts, bool excluded) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _isExcludedFromFee[accounts[i]] = excluded;
        }
    }

    function allowPreTrading(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _preTrader[accounts[i]] = true;
        }
    }

    function removePreTrading(address[] calldata accounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _preTrader[accounts[i]] = false;
        }
    }

    function unblockBot(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _isBot[account] = false;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20 {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

interface IBPool {
    function bind(address token, uint256 balance, uint256 denorm) external;
    function finalize() external;
    function setSwapFee(uint256 swapFee) external;
    function setPublicSwap(bool publicSwap) external;
    function setController(address controller) external;
    function isBound(address token) external view returns (bool);
    function getBalance(address token) external view returns (uint256);
    function getCurrentTokens() external view returns (address[] memory);
    function getFinalTokens() external view returns (address[] memory);
    function rebind(address token, uint256 balance, uint256 denorm) external;
    function unbind(address token) external;
    function joinPool(uint256 poolAmountOut, uint256[] memory maxAmountsIn) external;
    function exitPool(uint256 poolAmountIn, uint256[] memory minAmountsOut) external;
    function joinswapExternAmountIn(address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minPoolAmountOut) external returns (uint256 poolAmountOut);
    function exitswapPoolAmountIn(address tokenOut, uint256 poolAmountIn, uint256 minTokenAmountOut) external returns (uint256 tokenAmountOut);
}

contract ConfigurableRightsPool {
    address public bPool;
    address public controller;
    address public bPoolCreator;
    bool public publicSwapSet;
    bool public finalized;
    uint256 public swapFee;
    uint256 public cap;
    address[] public tokens;
    mapping(address => bool) public whitelistedLPs;
    mapping(address => uint256) public tokenBalances;
    mapping(address => uint256) public tokenWeights;

    event PoolCreated(address pool, uint256 initialSupply);
    event TokenAdded(address token);
    event TokenRemoved(address token);
    event WeightUpdated(address token, uint256 newWeight);
    event SwapFeeUpdated(uint256 newFee);
    event PublicSwapUpdated(bool enabled);
    event ControllerUpdated(address newController);
    event CapUpdated(uint256 newCap);
    event LPWhitelisted(address lp);
    event LPRemoved(address lp);
    event PoolJoined(address user, uint256 amount);
    event PoolExited(address user, uint256 amount);

    error ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH();
    error ERR_TRANSFER_FAILED();
    error ERR_NOT_CONTROLLER();
    error ERR_NOT_WHITELISTED();
    error ERR_POOL_FINALIZED();
    error ERR_NOT_FINALIZED();
    error ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
    error ERR_INVALID_TOKEN();
    error ERR_INVALID_AMOUNT();
    error ERR_CAP_EXCEEDED();

    modifier onlyController() {
        if (msg.sender != controller) revert ERR_NOT_CONTROLLER();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyWhitelisted() {
        if (!whitelistedLPs[msg.sender]) revert ERR_NOT_WHITELISTED();
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotFinalized() {
        if (finalized) revert ERR_POOL_FINALIZED();
        _;
    }

    modifier whenFinalized() {
        if (!finalized) revert ERR_NOT_FINALIZED();
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _bPoolCreator) {
        controller = msg.sender;
        bPoolCreator = _bPoolCreator;
    }

    function create(
        address _bPool,
        address[] calldata _tokens,
        uint256[] calldata _balances,
        uint256[] calldata _weights,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        bool _finalize
    ) external onlyController {
        if (_tokens.length != _balances.length || _tokens.length != _weights.length) 
            revert ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH();
        
        bPool = _bPool;
        tokens = _tokens;
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = _tokens[i];
            uint256 balance = _balances[i];
            uint256 weight = _weights[i];
            
            tokenBalances[token] = balance;
            tokenWeights[token] = weight;
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), balance);
            IBPool(bPool).bind(token, balance, weight);
        }
        
        if (_finalize) {
            IBPool(bPool).finalize();
            finalized = true;
        }
        
        emit PoolCreated(bPool, _initialSupply);
    }

    function createSmartPool(
        address _bPool,
        address _controller,
        string calldata _name,
        string calldata _symbol,
        address[] calldata _tokens,
        uint256[] calldata _balances,
        uint256[] calldata _weights,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        uint256 _swapFee,
        uint256 _cap,
        bool _publicSwap,
        bool _finalize
    ) external onlyController {
        bPool = _bPool;
        controller = _controller;
        swapFee = _swapFee;
        cap = _cap;
        publicSwapSet = _publicSwap;
        tokens = _tokens;
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = _tokens[i];
            uint256 balance = _balances[i];
            uint256 weight = _weights[i];
            
            tokenBalances[token] = balance;
            tokenWeights[token] = weight;
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), balance);
            IBPool(bPool).bind(token, balance, weight);
        }
        
        IBPool(bPool).setSwapFee(_swapFee);
        IBPool(bPool).setPublicSwap(_publicSwap);
        IBPool(bPool).setController(address(this));
        
        if (_finalize) {
            IBPool(bPool).finalize();
            finalized = true;
        }
        
        emit PoolCreated(bPool, _initialSupply);
    }

    function setPublicSwap(address _bPool, bool _publicSwap) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        IBPool(_bPool).setPublicSwap(_publicSwap);
        publicSwapSet = _publicSwap;
        emit PublicSwapUpdated(_publicSwap);
    }

    function setSwapFee(address _bPool, uint256 _swapFee) external onlyController {
        IBPool(_bPool).setSwapFee(_swapFee);
        swapFee = _swapFee;
        emit SwapFeeUpdated(_swapFee);
    }

    function setController(address _bPool, address _newController) external onlyController {
        IBPool(_bPool).setController(_newController);
        controller = _newController;
        emit ControllerUpdated(_newController);
    }

    function setCap(address _bPool, uint256 _cap) external onlyController {
        cap = _cap;
        emit CapUpdated(_cap);
    }

    function increaseWeight(
        address _bPool,
        address _token,
        uint256 _newWeight,
        uint256 _additionalBalance
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        uint256 currentBalance = IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(_token);
        uint256 newBalance = currentBalance + _additionalBalance;
        
        IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _additionalBalance);
        IBPool(_bPool).rebind(_token, newBalance, _newWeight);
        
        tokenBalances[_token] = newBalance;
        tokenWeights[_token] = _newWeight;
        
        emit WeightUpdated(_token, _newWeight);
    }

    function decreaseWeight(
        address _bPool,
        address _token,
        uint256 _newWeight,
        uint256 _balanceToRemove
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        uint256 currentBalance = IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(_token);
        uint256 newBalance = currentBalance - _balanceToRemove;
        
        IBPool(_bPool).rebind(_token, newBalance, _newWeight);
        IERC20(_token).transfer(msg.sender, _balanceToRemove);
        
        tokenBalances[_token] = newBalance;
        tokenWeights[_token] = _newWeight;
        
        emit WeightUpdated(_token, _newWeight);
    }

    function finalize(address _bPool) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        IBPool(_bPool).finalize();
        finalized = true;
    }

    function removeToken(
        address _bPool,
        address _token,
        uint256 _balanceToRemove
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        IBPool(_bPool).unbind(_token);
        IERC20(_token).transfer(controller, _balanceToRemove);
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            if (tokens[i] == _token) {
                tokens[i] = tokens[tokens.length - 1];
                tokens.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
        
        delete tokenBalances[_token];
        delete tokenWeights[_token];
        
        emit TokenRemoved(_token);
    }

    function joinSmartPool(
        address _bPool,
        uint256 _poolAmountOut,
        uint256[] calldata _maxAmountsIn
    ) external onlyWhitelisted whenFinalized {
        uint256 poolTotalSupply = IERC20(bPool).balanceOf(address(this));
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _maxAmountsIn.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            uint256 maxAmountIn = _maxAmountsIn[i];
            
            uint256 tokenBalance = IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(token);
            uint256 ratio = _poolAmountOut * 1e18 / poolTotalSupply;
            uint256 amountIn = tokenBalance * ratio / 1e18;
            
            if (amountIn > maxAmountIn) revert ERR_INVALID_AMOUNT();
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
        }
        
        IBPool(_bPool).joinPool(_poolAmountOut, _maxAmountsIn);
        
        emit PoolJoined(msg.sender, _poolAmountOut);
    }

    function whitelistLiquidityProvider(address _bPool, address _lp) external onlyController {
        whitelistedLPs[_lp] = true;
        emit LPWhitelisted(_lp);
    }

    function removeWhitelistedLiquidityProvider(address _bPool, address _lp) external onlyController {
        whitelistedLPs[_lp] = false;
        emit LPRemoved(_lp);
    }

    function updateWeight(address _bPool, address _token, uint256 _newWeight) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        uint256 currentBalance = IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(_token);
        IBPool(_bPool).rebind(_token, currentBalance, _newWeight);
        
        tokenWeights[_token] = _newWeight;
        emit WeightUpdated(_token, _newWeight);
    }

    function updateWeightsGradually(
        address _bPool,
        uint256[] calldata _newWeights,
        uint256 _startBlock,
        uint256 _endBlock
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (_newWeights.length != tokens.length) revert ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH();
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            uint256 newWeight = _newWeights[i];
            
            IBPool(_bPool).rebind(token, IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(token), newWeight);
            tokenWeights[token] = newWeight;
        }
    }

    function commitAddToken(
        address _bPool,
        address _token,
        uint256 _balance,
        uint256 _weight
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _balance);
        IBPool(_bPool).bind(_token, _balance, _weight);
        
        tokens.push(_token);
        tokenBalances[_token] = _balance;
        tokenWeights[_token] = _weight;
        
        emit TokenAdded(_token);
    }

    function applyAddToken(address _bPool, address _token, uint256 _balance) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(_bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        uint256 currentBalance = IBPool(_bPool).getBalance(_token);
        uint256 newBalance = currentBalance + _balance;
        uint256 weight = tokenWeights[_token];
        
        IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _balance);
        IBPool(_bPool).rebind(_token, newBalance, weight);
        
        tokenBalances[_token] = newBalance;
    }

    function applyAddToken() external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        // Finalize pending token additions
    }

    function joinswapExternAmountIn(
        address _bPool,
        address _tokenIn,
        uint256 _amountIn,
        uint256 _minPoolAmountOut
    ) external onlyWhitelisted whenFinalized returns (uint256 poolAmountOut) {
        IERC20(_tokenIn).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amountIn);
        poolAmountOut = IBPool(_bPool).joinswapExternAmountIn(_tokenIn, _amountIn, _minPoolAmountOut);
        
        emit PoolJoined(msg.sender, poolAmountOut);
    }

    function setTokens(
        address _bPool,
        address[] calldata _tokens,
        uint256[] calldata _balances,
        uint256[] calldata _weights
    ) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (_tokens.length != _balances.length || _tokens.length != _weights.length) 
            revert ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH();
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = _tokens[i];
            uint256 balance = _balances[i];
            uint256 weight = _weights[i];
            
            if (IBPool(_bPool).isBound(token)) {
                IBPool(_bPool).rebind(token, balance, weight);
            } else {
                IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), balance);
                IBPool(_bPool).bind(token, balance, weight);
            }
            
            tokenBalances[token] = balance;
            tokenWeights[token] = weight;
        }
    }

    function newBPool() external view returns (address) {
        return bPool;
    }

    function createPool(uint256 _initialSupply, uint256 _swapFee, uint256 _cap) external onlyController {
        if (finalized) revert ERR_POOL_FINALIZED();
        
        IBPool(bPool).setSwapFee(_swapFee);
        IBPool(bPool).finalize();
        
        swapFee = _swapFee;
        cap = _cap;
        finalized = true;
        
        emit PoolCreated(bPool, _initialSupply);
    }

    function joinPool(address _bPool, uint256 _poolAmountOut, uint256[] calldata _maxAmountsIn) external onlyWhitelisted whenFinalized {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _maxAmountsIn.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            uint256 maxAmountIn = _maxAmountsIn[i];
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), maxAmountIn);
        }
        
        IBPool(_bPool).joinPool(_poolAmountOut, _maxAmountsIn);
        
        emit PoolJoined(msg.sender, _poolAmountOut);
    }

    function removeWhitelistedLiquidityProvider(address _lp) external onlyController {
        whitelistedLPs[_lp] = false;
        emit LPRemoved(_lp);
    }

    function whitelistLiquidityProvider(address _lp) external onlyController {
        whitelistedLPs[_lp] = true;
        emit LPWhitelisted(_lp);
    }

    function setController(address _newController) external onlyController {
        controller = _newController;
        emit ControllerUpdated(_newController);
    }

    function setCap(uint256 _cap) external onlyController {
        cap = _cap;
        emit CapUpdated(_cap);
    }

    function setPublicSwap(bool _publicSwap) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        publicSwapSet = _publicSwap;
        emit PublicSwapUpdated(_publicSwap);
    }

    function setSwapFee(uint256 _swapFee) external onlyController {
        swapFee = _swapFee;
        emit SwapFeeUpdated(_swapFee);
    }

    function removeToken(address _token, uint256 _balanceToRemove) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (!IBPool(bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        IBPool(bPool).unbind(_token);
        IERC20(_token).transfer(controller, _balanceToRemove);
        
        emit TokenRemoved(_token);
    }

    function getFinalTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return IBPool(bPool).getFinalTokens();
    }

    function getCurrentTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return IBPool(bPool).getCurrentTokens();
    }

    function commitAddToken(address _token, uint256 _balance, uint256 _weight) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (IBPool(bPool).isBound(_token)) revert ERR_TOKEN_NOT_BOUND();
        
        IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _balance);
        IBPool(bPool).bind(_token, _balance, _weight);
        
        emit TokenAdded(_token);
    }

    function updateWeightsGradually(uint256[] calldata _newWeights, uint256 _startBlock, uint256 _endBlock) external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        if (_newWeights.length != tokens.length) revert ERR_LENGTH_MISMATCH();
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            uint256 newWeight = _newWeights[i];
            
            IBPool(bPool).rebind(token, IBPool(bPool).getBalance(token), newWeight);
            tokenWeights[token] = newWeight;
        }
    }

    function joinswapExternAmountIn(address _tokenIn, uint256 _amountIn, uint256 _minPoolAmountOut) external onlyWhitelisted whenFinalized returns (uint256 poolAmountOut) {
        IERC20(_tokenIn).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amountIn);
        poolAmountOut = IBPool(bPool).joinswapExternAmountIn(_tokenIn, _amountIn, _minPoolAmountOut);
        
        emit PoolJoined(msg.sender, poolAmountOut);
    }

    function joinPool(uint256 _poolAmountOut, uint256[] calldata _maxAmountsIn) external onlyWhitelisted whenFinalized {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _maxAmountsIn.length; i++) {
            address token = tokens[i];
            uint256 maxAmountIn = _maxAmountsIn[i];
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), maxAmountIn);
        }
        
        IBPool(bPool).joinPool(_poolAmountOut, _maxAmountsIn);
        
        emit PoolJoined(msg.sender, _poolAmountOut);
    }

    function finalize() external onlyController whenNotFinalized {
        IBPool(bPool).finalize();
        finalized = true;
    }

    function newCrp(
        address _bPoolCreator,
        string calldata _name,
        string calldata _symbol,
        address[] calldata _tokens,
        uint256[] calldata _balances,
        uint256[] calldata _weights,
        uint256 _initialSupply,
        bool _publicSwap,
        bool _finalize,
        bool _cap,
        bool _whitelist,
        bool _right1,
        bool _right2
    ) external returns (address) {
        bPoolCreator = _bPoolCreator;
        
        // Create new CRP configuration
        tokens = _tokens;
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _tokens.length; i++) {
            address token = _tokens[i];
            uint256 balance = _balances[i];
            uint256 weight = _weights[i];
            
            IERC20(token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), balance);
            IBPool(bPool).bind(token, balance, weight);
            
            tokenBalances[token] = balance;
            tokenWeights[token] = weight;
        }
        
        if (_publicSwap) {
            IBPool(bPool).setPublicSwap(true);
            publicSwapSet = true;
        }
        
        if (_finalize) {
            IBPool(bPool).finalize();
            finalized = true;
        }
        
        return address(this);
    }

    function bPool() external view returns (address) {
        return bPool;
    }
}
